title: Operations Manager
description:
**About 79th East** 




 79th East Private Limited is a Hyderabad\-based investment services firm, an AMFI\-registered Mutual Fund Distributor (ARN\-364145\) and distributor of Portfolio Management Services (PMS Registration No. APRN10260\).
 



**The Role** 




 Own the end\-to\-end operations and trading\-floor function across Mutual Funds, PMS and Equity, from client onboarding and account opening through transaction processing, reconciliation, compliance, reporting and closure. Lead Operations Executives and coordinate Dealers, with ownership of accuracy, TATs, controls, escalations and floor discipline.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




 • Manage MF, PMS and Equity operations, including client onboarding, resident and NRI/NRO/OCI processes, KYC, FATCA/CRS, demat account opening, transactions, confirmations, reconciliation, records and closure.
 



 • Own purchases, redemptions, switches, SIP/STP/SWP, PMS transactions and equity\-related operational processes through completion, including PMS processes involving the ₹50 lakh minimum investment.
 



 • Coordinate with AMCs, CAMS, KFintech, PMS providers, custodians, broking companies and ecosystem stakeholders including BSE, NSE and AMFI.
 



 • Manage NRI operations and NRE/NRO/OCI\-related account and investment processes with appropriate compliance coordination.
 



 • Coordinate and supervise Dealers and Operations Executives; oversee accurate and timely order placement, ensuring the correct client, security, quantity, price and order type are entered as authorised. Monitor order errors, mismatches, pending orders, confirmations and execution issues, and ensure timely resolution while maintaining proper records, TATs, quality controls and day\-to\-day floor discipline.
 



 • Own rejections, transaction failures, reconciliation breaks, delays, mismatches and client escalations through closure.
 



 • Ensure compliance with AMFI, SEBI, APMI, KYC and AML requirements and maintain audit\-ready documentation.
 



 • Build SOPs, checklists and MIS; report operational exceptions, TATs, rejections and team performance to leadership.
 



**What You Must Bring** 




 • NISM Series II\-B (RTA – Mutual Fund) — Mandatory.
 



 • 5\+ years in MF/PMS/Equity Operations, preferably with an AMC, MFD, wealth management firm, broking company or financial\-services organisation.
 



 • Proven experience managing end\-to\-end onboarding, demat opening, NRI operations, reconciliations, escalations and operational controls.
 



 • Strong knowledge of CAMS, KFintech, BSE Star MF, MF Utilities, PMS, demat and transaction/broking platforms.
 



 • Working knowledge of BSE, NSE and AMFI\-related coordination and operational requirements.
 



 • Strong team\-monitoring, team\-coordination and floor\-management capability, including supervision of Dealers and Operations Executives.
 



 • Strong Excel, MIS and documentation skills, with the ability to build and improve processes and controls.
 



 • Proficiency in Claude AI and other AI productivity tools for SOP creation, documentation, MIS analysis, reporting and workflow improvement, with strong awareness of data confidentiality.
 



 • Graduate; Commerce/Finance preferred.
 
 Hyderabad locals preferred.
 
 Hyderabad\-based; on\-site at Ameerpet.
 



**Added Advantage** 




 NISM V\-A/XXI\-A; NRI operations; experience building operations from scratch; CRM/portfolio systems; Telugu/Hindi.
 



**Package** 




 ₹6 LPA CTC \+ Performance Bonus \| Ameerpet, Hyderabad \| Full\-time, On\-site \| Manages Operations Executives and coordinates Dealers
 



**Apply** 




 Send CV to info@79the.com with subject
 **“Operations Manager \- Hyderabad”** 
 , mentioning NISM II\-B validity, team size managed and platforms handled. Hyderabad locals preferred.
 



 You can also
 **apply directly through our Careers page:** 
 Careers — 79th East
 



**79th East is an equal\-opportunity employer.**

title: Production Planning & Inventory Management
description:
Job Description: Manager \- Production Planning \& Inventory Management
   

  

**Business Unit:** 
 Aluminium Plant
   

  

**Location:** 
 Hyderabad (Hyd Alu Plant)
   

  

**Experience:** 
 12\-14 Years
   

  

**Qualification:** 
 B.Tech (Mechanical)
   

  

**Reporting To:** 
 Sumit Arora
   

  

**Position Type:** 
 Replacement
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for an experienced Production Planning \& Inventory Management professional from the manufacturing industry to manage production planning, machine loading, inventory control, and on\-time delivery. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring smooth plant operations, optimizing production efficiency, and coordinating with sales, production, quality, and logistics teams.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

**Production Planning \& Scheduling**
* Prepare raw material requirement plans and production schedules based on sales forecasts.
* Develop section\-wise weekly and monthly production plans.
* Schedule production using production planning tools.
* Calculate machine hours and manpower requirements.
* Prepare machine loading plans considering shop floor WIP.
* Monitor production plan adherence and follow up with production in\-charges.
* Identify production constraints and implement corrective actions.
* Plan daily and monthly job orders for multiple OEM customer requirements and JIT supply.


**Inventory \& Material Management**
* Ensure timely availability of raw materials for production and on\-time delivery.
* Coordinate with raw material stores for smooth execution of production plans.
* Communicate material shortages to stores and the sales department.
* Manage STU item inventory and implement FIFO practices.
* Monitor reorder requirements and conduct root cause analysis (RCA).
* Implement JIT planning wherever required.


**Production Efficiency \& Process Improvement**
* Analyze production performance against customer delivery index and planned efficiency.
* Conduct time studies, method studies, and line balancing for various models.
* Establish standard times for production activities.
* Monitor and improve line efficiency and productivity.
* Support productivity and quality improvement initiatives.
* Ensure adherence to production targets and optimize machine utilization.


**Coordination \& MIS Reporting**
* Coordinate with Sales and Installation teams to communicate expected delivery dates (EDD).
* Reconfirm production orders and communicate delays to the Sales department.
* Prioritize customer urgencies on the shop floor and highlight them on batch sheets.
* Coordinate with the Quality Department for final QA output.
* Collaborate with Commercial, Production, Logistics, and InterPlant teams.
* Prepare and present MIS reports to top management.
* Support team building and employee development.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills**
* B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering.
* 12\-14 years of relevant experience.
* Manufacturing industry experience is mandatory.
* Strong experience in production planning, scheduling, and inventory management.
* Hands\-on knowledge of machine loading and production planning.
* Experience in manpower planning, time study, and line balancing.
* Knowledge of engineering drawings and production processes.
* Strong understanding of JIT planning and on\-time delivery.
* Good communication, leadership, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to coordinate with multiple departments and manage critical orders.


 Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
   

  

* On\-time delivery (OTD) achievement.
* Production plan adherence.
* Inventory optimization and material availability.
* Machine and manpower utilization.
* Production efficiency and productivity improvement.
* Customer delivery index.
* Timely MIS reporting and issue resolution.

 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

**Summary**
 The Client Onboarding Managerwill lead and oversee the execution of client onboarding activities across onshore and offshore teams, with a primary focus on driving efficiency, consistency, and high\-quality delivery. This role serves as a central coordination point across cross\-functional partners, ensuring seamless onboarding, data migration, and offboarding processes while maintaining strong governance, reporting, and operational discipline. This role plays a key part in delivering a seamless onboarding experience, with exposure to KYC, deal documentation, and lifecycle events.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Onboarding Coordination \& Execution**
 Own and manage end\-to\-end onboarding activities for routine to moderately complex client engagements (L1–L3\).
   

  

* Execute and oversee onboarding workflows, ensuring adherence to defined processes, timelines, and quality standards.
* Support the full onboarding lifecycle, including:
* Client setup and activation
* Data migration coordination and tracking
* Offboarding, transitions, and deal closures
* Ensure all onboarding documentation, deliverables, and records are accurately completed and maintained.


**Cross\-Functional Stakeholder Management**
* Act as the primary coordination point across internal teams to drive seamless onboarding execution, including:
+ Lead/participate in kickoffs, status calls, and follow\-ups
+ Line of Business (LOB) teams, Legal \& Compliance, Core Client Delivery Operations (Investor Services, Payments, Platform Delivery/Technology, Reconciliations), Onshore Client Onboarding teams

* Track cross\-functional dependencies and proactively follow up to ensure timely completion of tasks.
* Identify risks and blockers early, escalating issues to senior onboarding leadership as appropriate.


**Workflow Management \& Governance**
* Coordinate and review KYC/AML documentation (entity data, ownership, tax forms)
* Assist with deal document review (credit agreements, fee letters, legal docs)
* Support closing readiness, ensuring all required documentation is complete and accurate
* Ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory standards
* In larger programs: Own the execution and tracking of sub\-workflows within broader onboarding programs.
* Ensure all workflow tasks are completed, validated, and formally signed off in accordance with governance standards.
* Perform readiness assessments in advance of key onboarding milestones and go\-live events.


**Data Migration Oversight**
* Coordinate and monitor data migration activities, providing regular updates on status, risks, and dependencies.
* Partner with technology, data, and operations teams to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and integrity.
* Support validation, reconciliation, and issue resolution related to migrated data.
* Escalate discrepancies or delays to ensure timely remediation.


**Offboarding \& Transition Management**
* Lead the coordination and execution of client or deal offboarding activities, ensuring smooth and controlled transitions.
* Track and validate closure activities, including account shutdowns, data transfers, and reconciliations.
* Ensure all offboarding activities comply with regulatory, contractual, and operational requirements.


**Reporting, Insights \& Continuous Improvement**
* Deliver regular status reporting on onboarding progress, risks, milestones, and performance metrics.
* Maintain and enhance onboarding tracking tools and dashboards (e.g., workflow trackers, migration logs, sign\-off records).
* Provide reporting and insights to senior onboarding leadership and key stakeholders.
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying process inefficiencies, risks, and opportunities to enhance scalability, automation, and overall onboarding effectiveness.


**Process Improvement**
* Identify workflow gaps and support improvements to onboarding processes
* Contribute to SOPs, templates, and best practices for agency onboarding


**Specific Responsibilites Include**
* Lead client onboarding communication, including kickoff calls, recurring status updates, and meeting recaps, ensuring clear alignment across stakeholders
* Establish and manage onboarding frameworks, including folder structures, checklists, and required setup activities (e.g., SFTP, distribution lists, bank setup, branding)

* Track and coordinate legal and closing documentation, including credit agreements, fee letters, and closing sets, ensuring completeness and accuracy

title: Senior Manager, Incentive Compensation Administration Lead
description:
Join Amgen's Mission of Serving Patients
   

  

 At Amgen, if you feel like you're part of something bigger, it's because you are. Our shared mission \- to serve patients living with serious illnesses \- drives all that we do.
   

  

 Since 1980, we've helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world's toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas \- Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease \- we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you'll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller, happier lives.
   

  

 Our award\-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science\-based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lie within them, you'll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Senior Manager, Incentive Compensation Administration Lead will provide senior leadership for the accurate, timely, compliant, and scalable administration of field incentive compensation programs. The role will lead delivery across internal and external teams in AIN and India, while managing relationships across a complex set of internal teams and functional groups.
   

  

 This is a high\-impact role responsible for end\-to\-end IC administration and operations, including cycle delivery, data and calculation controls, payment readiness, governance, platform operations, and continuous improvement. The role will serve as a trusted operational partner to Amgen’s U.S. Commercial organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Key Integrator: Act as the main point of contact and representative in India for the Incentive Compensation Administration team.
* Talent Development: Train, develop, and manage talent to meet organizational needs.
* Incentive Compensation Administration and Operational Leadership
+ Lead the accurate, timely, and compliant administration of approved IC plans and compensation cycles, ensuring plan rules, governance requirements, internal controls, and business timelines are consistently met.
+ Oversee end\-to\-end operational delivery across data intake, eligibility validation, crediting, calculation review, payment\-file preparation, payout coordination, reconciliations, exception management, reporting, and post\-payment validation.
+ Monitor operational performance, payout trends, processing timelines, data\-quality issues, field inquiries, and potential outliers; escalate material risks and drive appropriate corrective actions with stakeholders.

* Operational Excellence, Governance, and Delivery:
+ Lead end\-to\-end IC program operations, ensuring quality, scalability, and operational efficiency while establishing clear delivery priorities, service levels, quality controls, and accountability across the team and vendor partners.
+ Establish and enforce governance standards by ensuring robust documentation practices, traceable audit trails, and effective control mechanisms across incentive compensation operations.
+ Lead operational management of the IC technology platform, partnering with IT, vendors, and IC stakeholders to support platform enhancements, integrations, testing, and effective implementation of approved changes.
+ Serve as the senior subject matter expert for IC operational data and administration, providing guidance and actionable solutions for data\-related challenges, calculation questions, and complex field inquiries.

* Automation, Technology, and Continuous Improvement:
+ Lead identification, prioritization, testing, and implementation of automation opportunities that strengthen IC administration, controls, accuracy, timeliness, and scalability.
+ Support the evaluation and adoption of approved AI\-enabled and digital solutions by providing IC administration domain expertise and validating operational readiness, controls, and outputs.

* Lead the identification and prioritization of process improvements across IC administration, documentation, reporting, data controls, and vendor ways of working.
* Stakeholder and Delivery Management: Partner with global stakeholders to clarify operational requirements, coordinate decisions and delivery milestones, resolve issues, communicate progress, and ensure IC administration delivers a reliable field experience.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* Master’s degree \& 10\+ years of experience in Incentive Compensation administration and operations.
* Bachelor’s degree \& 12\+ years of experience in Incentive Compensation administration and operations.
* 3\+ years of leadership experience directly managing people, teams, projects, programs, and directing the allocation of resources.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Relevant sales force effectiveness, sales operations, and field platforms and systems (i.e. CRM, sales operations enablement, reporting) in the bio/pharmaceutical industry and/or consulting experience.
* Analytical Skills: The ability to analyze data, identify trends, and make data\-driven decisions is crucial. This includes proficiency in statistical analysis and familiarity with tools like Excel, SQL, and data visualization software.
* Technical Proficiency: Knowledge of relevant software and technologies, such as sales planning and operations platforms (targeting, alignment and roster management, incentive compensation), sales CRM, and other field\-specific tools, is important.
* Critical Thinking: Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to diagnose complex IC operational issues, assess risk, and implement practical, compliant solutions.
* Project Management: Ability to lead cross\-functional teams to manage IC administration initiatives, platform enhancements, annual cycles, and process improvements.
* Collaboration: Ability to work effectively with stakeholders to ensure alignment and support for initiatives
* Communication: Effective communication is key, both in writing and verbally. This includes the ability to present data and findings clearly to stakeholders and team members.
* Oral, written and presentation skills to explain complex concepts and controversial findings clearly to a variety of audiences, including senior management
* Comfortable challenging the status quo and bringing forward innovative solutions
* Ability to identify areas for process and systems innovation and implement change that will enhance the overall effectiveness of the team

The Associate Director translates the Global Data Operations and governance roadmap into Hyderabad execution plans, while also shaping priorities, risk decisions, standards, adoption measures, and value outcomes through regional, global, and cross\-functional forums. Working closely with Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Product Development, Process Intelligence, Global Data Operations, and BP\&T, the role builds a scalable data operating model across data foundation, mapping, stewardship, controls, lifecycle management, service performance, and continuous improvement. The role also develops data capability, coaches the Hyderabad team and matrix partners, and educates stakeholders on the business value of accurate, trusted, governed, and well\-managed data.
   

  

**Scope and Impact**
* Lead and influence cross\-functional data operations, governance, data quality, NPI readiness, and digital enablement initiatives with high organizational impact across GSC and the Hyderabad hub.
* Translate GSC, BP\&T, and Global Data Operations strategy into integrated roadmaps, execution priorities, decision points, KPIs, adoption measures, and measurable business outcomes.
* Provide strategic input to leadership and governance forums on data priorities, investment needs, operating model maturity, risks, trade\-offs, sequencing, and value realization.
* Strengthen decision making by connecting master data, process performance, data quality, operational controls, product lifecycle requirements, system impacts, and business outcomes.
* Operate as a regional data leader and matrix influencer, creating alignment across global, regional, and Hyderabad\-based teams on governance expectations, standards, accountabilities, and execution discipline.


**Duties/Responsibilities**
* Lead the Hyderabad Data Operations organization responsible for master data creation, extension, maintenance, remediation, obsoletion, and operational data services across GSC.
* Serve as the Hyderabad voice of data, representing data priorities, risks, opportunities, value outcomes, and improvement needs across regional, global, and cross\-functional forums.
* Shape and translate the Global Data Operations and governance roadmap into Hyderabad execution plans with clear milestones, ownership, adoption measures, controls, KPIs, and value outcomes.
* Lead cross\-functional, complex initiatives across data quality, governance, data foundation, data mapping, lifecycle management, workflow optimization, automation, service maturity, and data operations scalability.
* Lead NPI and launch master data readiness by ensuring timely, accurate, governed, and risk\-managed data execution across planning, manufacturing, quality, serialization, distribution, and supply chain processes.
* Strengthen master data governance by embedding standards, business rules, stewardship responsibilities, controls, escalation routines, and data quality disciplines into operational delivery.
* Partner with Process Intelligence to connect process maps, data flows, process performance, data quality insights, operational pain points, and improvement opportunities into an integrated operating model.
* Use data quality measures, KPIs, service levels, stakeholder feedback, and issue trends to identify root causes, prioritize interventions, and drive measurable improvement in accuracy, timeliness, productivity, transparency, and stakeholder experience.
* Identify and influence opportunities for standardization, automation, workflow redesign, self\-service, digital enablement, and AI\-ready data foundations to reduce manual effort and improve scalability.
* Provide strategic input and recommendations to governance and leadership forums, including risks, mitigations, trade\-offs, dependencies, resource needs, adoption barriers, and decision options.
* Educate stakeholders on master data principles, governance expectations, stewardship models, data quality impacts, and the business value of trusted data in practical business language.
* Build strong partnerships with Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Product Development, Process Intelligence, Global Data Operations, and BP\&T to resolve complex data challenges and improve business outcomes.
* Develop data literacy and maturity across the Hyderabad and regional stakeholder community through forums, coaching, communications, training content, playbooks, and practical guidance.
* Develop and coach the Hyderabad Data Operations team and matrix partners by creating clarity on priorities, accountabilities, development opportunities, delivery expectations, and continuous improvement behaviors.
* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, quality, data integrity, audit readiness, and company requirements across data operations processes.
* Act as an SME and strategic advisor to projects and initiatives that create, change, rely on, or are impacted by GSC data capabilities, including reporting, analytics, process intelligence, digital transformation, and AI\-enabled use cases.


**Reporting Relationship**
* This position has a solid line reporting relationship to the Senior Director, Global Supply Chain Hyderabad Lead.
* This position has a dotted line reporting relationship to the Director, Global Data Operations, ensuring alignment to global data operations standards, priorities, and roadmap execution.
* This position has people management responsibility for the Hyderabad Data Operations team, while also leading through matrix influence across global, regional, and Hyderabad\-based stakeholders.


**Qualifications**
* Education Master, MBA, Engineering degree, or Bachelor degree with equivalent experience in supply chain, management, information systems, data management, engineering, life sciences, technology, or a related discipline.
* Advanced certification in Supply Chain Management strongly preferred, such as APICS CSCP / CPIM.
* Lean Six Sigma, data management, operational excellence, PMP, or equivalent certification preferred.
* 8\+ years of experience in supply chain, data operations, master data management, data governance, business transformation, or related business functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading and influencing operational teams and cross\-functional initiatives in a global, matrixed environment, including people development, coaching, capability building, performance management, and stakeholder alignment.
* Expertise across multiple supply chain data processes and capabilities, with strong understanding of end\-to\-end interdependencies, bottlenecks, risks, and business performance impacts.
* Strong understanding of supply chain master data structures, governance models, stewardship models, business rules, controls, data quality practices, and lifecycle management processes.
* Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), launch readiness, product lifecycle management, or master data readiness for supply chain execution.
* Proven ability to develop and execute roadmaps, translate strategy into operational plans, influence governance decisions, manage priorities, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
* Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders across Supply Chain, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, IT, Product Development, Process Intelligence, Global Data Operations, and business transformation.
* Strong experience using KPIs, service levels, data quality metrics, risk management, and continuous improvement methods to improve operational execution and stakeholder experience.
* Exposure to ERP and supply chain platforms such as SAP S/4HANA and associated planning, workflow, reporting, analytics, data governance, or data quality tools preferred.
* Executive communication, stakeholder engagement, influencing, education, and decision\-support skills, with the ability to explain complex data topics in practical business terms.
* Ability to build consensus, resolve conflict, manage risk, and align teams around standards, controls, governance, operating model maturity, and operational execution.
* Change leadership mindset with ability to lead through ambiguity, evolving priorities, digital transformation, and compliance expectations while maintaining operational discipline and data integrity.


**AD\-Level Competency Alignment**
* Leadership scope leads and influences cross\-functional activities and complex projects with high organizational impact, requiring enterprise stakeholder management.
* Strategic contribution reflects an AD\-level 40% strategy / 60% operations profile by shaping roadmap priorities, governance decisions, trade\-offs, and value realization while ensuring disciplined execution.
* Technical breadth demonstrates expertise across multiple supply chain data processes and capabilities, with end\-to\-end understanding of dependencies, bottlenecks, and risks.
* Digital and data impact leads implementation and adoption of digital, data quality, workflow, reporting, analytics, governance, and AI\-ready data capabilities with clear business value.

* Stakeholder influence communicates effectively with internal and external stakeholders at all levels, influences requirements and decisions, and builds alignment across program, departmental, and functional forums.
* Leadership behaviors coaches others, cultivates growth mindset, supports capability building, manages conflict proactively, and uses delegation and development opportunities to strengthen team and matrix partner capability.

title: GPO - Hire to Retire
description:
We are Reckitt
   

  

 Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
   

  

 Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
   

  

 Global Business Services
   

  

 Behind our iconic power brands that touch millions of lives daily – from Dettol and Lysol to Durex and Nurofen – lies a dynamic and vital engine: Reckitt's Global Business Services (GBS).
   

  

 Fuelled by a culture of positive energy and co\-creativity \- while learning together \- OneReckitt GBS is at the forefront of our business, driving efficiency, standardisation, and innovation across our global operations. We're a fast\-paced, purposeful team, constantly seeking to optimise our processes, leverage cutting\-edge technology, and deliver exceptional value to every corner of Reckitt. We’re not a traditional back\-office function; we’re a strategic powerhouse where diverse individuals with bright minds come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better global business that directly helps achieve Reckitt’s mission.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As the Global Process Owner (GPO) – Hire to Retire (H2R) you will be accountable for shaping and governing the end\-to\-end design, and continuous improvement of the global H2R process landscape. The role ensures standardisation, simplification, scalability, and business\-alignment across the employee lifecycle, from talent acquisition through onboarding, performance, development, mobility, and offboarding.
   

  

 This role sits at the heart of enabling an exceptional employee experience while ensuring operational efficiency, compliance, and alignment with Reckitt’s talent strategy. You will collaborate with HR Centers of Expertise (COEs), Global People Services (Shared Services), IT\&D, and other Global Process Owners in Global business services to drive process design, technology enablement, and continuous improvement across the full hire\-to\-retire value chain.
   

  

 Note: This role is not responsible for running day\-to\-day HR Shared Services operations. Instead, the GPO partners with Global People Services to deliver process improvements, automation, and simplification across all markets, ensuring operational execution aligns with process design and governance standards.
   

  

 Your responsibilities
   

  

* Define and own the global end\-to\-end H2R process strategy, standards, and governance framework
* Lead global design authority for H2R processes including hiring, onboarding, core HR operations, payroll, time \& attendance, and offboarding
* Champion process harmonization and digitization across markets, in partnership with HR, IT, and GBS
* Identify and deliver transformation opportunities that improve employee experience and operational performance
* Ensure compliance with regulatory, policy, and data privacy requirements across the H2R process landscape
* Drive adoption and optimization of H2R platforms (e.g., Workday, ServiceNow, payroll solutions)
* Monitor process performance and drive continuous improvement through KPIs and feedback loops


 The experience we're looking for
   

  

* Deep understanding of the HR function and full employee lifecycle, with extensive experience designing and leading global H2R processes in a multinational company
* Demonstrated success in process transformation, automation, and employee experience enhancement. Proven experience as a H2R GPO or Head of HR Shared Services operations preferred
* Hands\-on experience with global HR technologies (Workday, SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, ATS, payroll systems)
* Experience working in or closely with a Global Business Services or Shared Services model
* Demonstrated expertise in process ownership, transformation, and governance
* Proven ability to influence and align diverse stakeholders across functions and regions
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a data\-driven mindset
* Strong exposure to GBS ramp\-up and mature environments, with a track record of scaling operations and evolving processes
* FMCG or other high\-volume, fast\-paced industry background preferred


 The skills for success
   

  

* Global Process Design
* Hire to Retire
* HR Operations
* HRIS Platforms (e.g., Workday)
* Payroll \& Time Management
* Employee Experience Design
* Process Transformation
* Stakeholder Engagement
* Compliance \& Risk Management
* GBS Collaboration


 What we offer
   

  

 With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
   

  

 We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short\-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
   

  

 Equality
   

  

 We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

 This role serves as the primary IT interface for the regional organization, ensuring strong alignment between regional business priorities, Honeywell Global Digital \& IT (GDM), and the Building Automation IT strategy. The role requires a leader who can operate effectively in a high\-growth, highly diverse regional landscape, while building a strong, scalable, and future\-ready IT organization.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Business Partnership**
* Act as a trusted technology and digital advisor to BA regional leadership across India, Middle East, and Rest of Asia.
* Translate regional BA growth, customer, and operational strategies into clear IT demand, roadmaps, and investment priorities.
* Shape and influence business decisions by providing technology insights, trade\-off analysis, and risk perspectives.

* Balance regional responsiveness with global standardization, ensuring scalable and compliant solutions.
* Partner with GDM, COEs, and global IT teams to prioritize initiatives, manage dependencies, and ensure delivery discipline.


**People Leadership \& Organization Building**
* Build, lead, and continuously strengthen a high\-performing IT organization across the regions, including India and Middle East hubs.
* Provide direct people leadership with accountability for talent acquisition, performance management, succession planning, and leadership development.
* Develop strong regional IT leadership bench strength, coaching senior leaders and high\-potential talent.
* Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, inclusion, innovation, and continuous improvement.


**Governance, Stakeholder \& Financial Management**
* Establish and operate effective IT governance, demand management, and investment review mechanisms across the region.
* Ensure disciplined budget management, cost optimization, and vendor performance management.
* Drive transparency in IT performance, value realization, and risk management with regional and global stakeholders.


**Operational Excellence, Risk \& Compliance**
* Ensure reliable, secure, and resilient IT services supporting BA sales, services, engineering, and operations across the regions.
* Champion cybersecurity, data privacy, and regulatory compliance, including region\-specific requirements.
* Proactively manage operational, delivery, and third\-party risks in a complex multi\-country environment.


**Critical Competencies \& Capabilities**

* People Leadership \& Organization Building – Proven success in building, scaling, and leading geographically distributed, multicultural teams.

* Executive Presence \& Communication – Strong ability to engage, influence, and communicate with senior stakeholders across cultures.

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Engineering, or related discipline; Master’s degree preferred.
* 15\+ years of progressive IT leadership experience, including senior roles as an IT Business Partner or equivalent.
* Strong experience working with senior business leaders in global or regional roles, preferably in high\-growth markets.
* Solid background in enterprise applications, digital platforms, cybersecurity, and IT governance.
* Demonstrated people management experience, including leading leaders and building regional organizations.
* Experience in Building Automation, Industrial, Smart Buildings, or B2B technology environments strongly preferred.


**About Us**
 Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure\-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission\-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

**Skill and Experience:**

* Strong knowledge of DevOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, automation, observability, monitoring, and performance engineering.
* Experience leading platform modernization and enterprise technology transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to define engineering standards, governance frameworks, and development best practices.
* Strong understanding of AI\-enabled engineering practices and leveraging emerging technologies to improve developer productivity.
* Experience managing cross\-functional, distributed, vendor, and matrixed engineering teams.
* Proven success delivering complex, multi\-team programs in Agile and product\-centric environments.
* Expertise in API management, integration platforms, service orchestration, and enterprise connectivity patterns.

title: GCC Advisory Consultant
description:
**Job Title –** 
 GCC Advisory Consultant
   

  

**Management Level:** 
 09 – Consultant
   

  

**Location:** 
 Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Chennai, Kolkata

 GCC / GBS Strategy, Functional Operating Model, GCC/ Shared Services Design Design, Setup and Transformation, Sourcing \& Location Strategy, Business Case Formulation, Functional Transformation such as Finance Process (O2C / P2P / R2R / FP\&A) Transformation, PowerPoint \& Excel

 Multi\-function GBS, Transition \& Migration Management, Service Management \& SLA Design, Agentic AI in functions, Data Visualization Tools
   

  

**Job Summary:**
* Manage defined workstreams within GBS / GCC and operating model transformation engagements, taking responsibility for structuring the approach, shaping the analysis, and delivering high\-quality outputs within agreed timelines
* Take ownership of specific solution modules – such as Org design, location assessment or a process tower (e.g., O2C, P2P, R2R/FP\&A) – guiding analysts, reviewing outputs, and ensuring coherence across deliverables at the workstream level
* Prepare client presentations, workshop materials, and proposal sections independently, contributing actively to client discussions and working sessions
* Develop business cases, cost analyses, value realization frameworks, and supporting models for GBS / SSC setup and transformation assignments
* Apply a process and operating\-model perspective across GBS design, governance, KPI and maturity frameworks, and emerging areas such as Gen AI–enabled processes
* Contribute to business development efforts through research, pitch preparation, and proposal development


**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* GBS / GCC Strategy and Setup: Lead analysis of operating model options (centralized, federated, hybrid) and build\-operate setup models, location and sourcing strategy, GBS guiding principles, and process taxonomy (L0–L5\) design for new and scaling shared services
* Operating Model Design: Design integrated operating models for GBS / GCC setups, including organizational structure options, service delivery models, and transition, knowledge\-transfer, and stabilization planning considerations independently
* Operating Model: Manage the design, documentation, and continuous improvement of the Operating Model by analyzing processes, roles, governance, and performance metrics to enable efficient service delivery.
* Cost Analysis and Value Realization: Develop detailed cost models covering setup costs, run\-rate costs, and total cost of ownership for GBS and transformation scenarios; build value realization frameworks that track benefit and savings delivery against investment over time, incorporating productivity, quality, and strategic value levers
* Org Design and Sizing: Design organization structures for the GBS / SSC and retained teams – roles, spans and layers, reporting lines, and FTE sizing methodologies
* SSC Location Strategy: Conduct location assessment and selection studies across cost, talent availability, risk, and scalability dimensions to recommend best\-fit delivery locations for shared services
* KPI and Performance Frameworks: Design KPI and SLA frameworks for GBS performance management, covering operational, financial, service, and experience metrics; develop dashboards and reporting cadences aligned to governance structures
* Capability Maturity Assessment: Conduct structured maturity assessments across functions and processes against leading\-practice benchmarks; translate findings into prioritized improvement roadmaps with clear ownership and timelines
* Governance, RACI and Interaction Model Design: Design governance frameworks (councils, decision rights, escalation paths), RACI matrices, and interaction models defining roles and collaboration patterns between the GBS, retained organization, business units, and third\-party providers
* Gen AI in Functions: Manage assessments and recommendations on Gen AI and intelligent automation use cases across functional processes – such as AP invoice processing, reconciliations, close acceleration, and management reporting


**Professional \& Technical Skills:**
* 5–9 years of total experience in GBS consulting, operating model, functional transformation, or, advisory, or in\-house shared services; experience at a top\-tier or Big 4 firm preferred
* Experience leading workstreams in GBS / GCC design, functional operating model, or shared services engagements
* Working knowledge of at least 2–3 of the following: GBS / GCC / SSC setup, operating model design, sourcing \& location strategy, org design \& sizing, process maturity assessment, governance \& interaction model design
* Ability to build and interpret cost models, TCO analyses, and value realization frameworks and GBS transformation contexts
* Experience designing KPI and SLA frameworks and performance measurement structures; ability to translate strategic objectives into measurable operational metrics
* Familiarity with maturity assessment approaches – capability, process, or operating\-model maturity – and ability to develop actionable improvement roadmaps from findings
* Familiarity with core functional processes and process taxonomy frameworks such as the L0–L5 process hierarchy
* Awareness of Gen AI adoption in one or more functions including intelligent automation use cases and their implications for GBS process and workforce design
* Strong proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; exposure to data visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau); strong structured communication and presentation skills


**Additional Information:**
* Opportunity to work on GBS / GCC and operating model programs for marquee G2000 clients across industries
* Exposure to senior stakeholder engagements and client\-facing responsibilities as part of high\-performing delivery teams
* Potential to Co\-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
* Ability to embed responsible business into everything—from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
* Personalized training modules to develop your strategy \& consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
* Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

**Position Summary**
 Human Capital team helps Deloitte client service teams support value creation through people's performance. What should the AI strategy be for the HR function? Do they have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to help make work better for humans and humans better at work.
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 As an experienced Manager, you will oversee the delivery of enterprise\-scale change management solutions, lead cross\-functional teams, drive client conversations, and mentor junior practitioners. You will collaborate to understand overarching change requirements, support sales and proposal efforts, and drive end\-to\-end change management delivery, including resource estimations and strategic planning, to ensure successful outcomes.

* Fine tune your capabilities and build a sustainable leadership franchise that you can execute against in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment
* Network and train others in the firm, help others group through development and delivery of knowledge sharing

title: Strategic Sourcing Lead
description:
**Associate Manager, Talent Sourcing (GBS)** 




  





 About Randstad Enterprise
 



  





 As the leading global talent solutions provider, Randstad Enterprise enables companies to create sustainable business value and agility by keeping people at the heart of their organizations. Part of Randstad N.V., we combine unmatched talent data and market insights with smart technologies and deep people expertise. Our integrated talent solutions — delivered by Randstad Advisory, Randstad Sourceright and Randstad RiseSmart — help companies build skilled and agile workforces that move their businesses forward. Randstad Enterprise supports some of the world's most renowned brands to build their talent acquisition and management models that not only meet their business needs today but also in the future. We offer solutions in Europe, Middle East and Africa (EMEA) region, Asia Pacific (APAC) region as well as in North America (NAM) region. This results in a digital way of working and requires a proactive mind\-set.
 



  





 ● Our solutions know no limits, we have proven experience delivering market\-leading MSP, RPO, Total Talent, and Services Procurement Solutions including technology, talent marketing, talent intelligence, and workforce consulting services.
 



 ● We create the best talent experience, from attraction to onboarding and onto ongoing career development, we understand the human and digital touchpoints that compel talent to join and stay with a company.
 



 ● We know where the talent of tomorrow is, how they behave, what they are looking for, and how to build their loyalty toward a specific company employer brand.
 



 ● We push the boundaries of our industry to be able to see around the corner for our clients, continually investing in innovation to stay ahead in our market.
 



  





**About Team** 




 Our team is a group of talented and dedicated professionals who are passionate about our work and committed to delivering exceptional results. We are a global group that values collaboration, open communication, and a supportive work environment. Our team is responsible for Full Life Cycle Recruiting and Recruiting Operations for partnering with a global fortune\-500 client and we take pride in the important role we play in achieving the goals of our client's business. We are a diverse group with a range of skills and backgrounds, and we believe that our differences make us stronger. We are committed to fostering a culture of learning and growth, and we encourage each other to take on new challenges and develop our skills. We believe in working hard and having fun, and we enjoy celebrating our successes together as a team.
 



  





  





 Purpose of the Role
 



 ● Develops sourcing strategies that enhance candidate experience, ensuring a personalized approach to project\-based job opportunities.
 



 ● Works closely with the clients' hiring teams, ensuring all KPIs and SLA requirements regarding order\-based sourcing and talent conversion from passive candidates are met.
 



 ● Monitors and analyzes recruitment metrics and data to identify areas for improvement and optimize the recruitment process for passive and active candidates, considering candidates with limited online presence.
 



 ● Stays informed of industry best practices and trends in the career/hiring space, continually assessing where Randstad can tap into project\-based jobs.
 



 ● Leads sourcing activities/projects and drives to meet the key metrics goals as set by leadership, focusing on proactive engagement and headhunting of passive talent.
 



 ● Drives continuous improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing sourcing efficiency and effectiveness.
 



 ● Manages candidates and ensures that the most qualified candidates are shortlisted for clients' short\-term engagements.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




 ● SLA \& KPI Management: You will track the team's daily and monthly hiring targets. You'll look at the data to make sure candidates are moving through the hiring stages quickly and efficiently.
 



 ● Capacity \& Demand Planning: You will look at incoming hiring requests and assign work to your team fairly, making sure they can handle sudden rushes of new job openings.
 



 ● Upskilling \& Mentorship: You will coach and train your team members to improve their sourcing skills, teaching them how to find hard\-to\-reach tech professionals.
 



 ● Advanced Sourcing Frameworks: You will build smart plans to find passive candidates (people who aren't actively looking for a job) for complex IT roles like Cloud, Infrastructure, and Security.
 



 ● AI \& Tech Stack Optimization: You will guide the team on how to best use modern recruitment tools, databases, and AI sourcing technology to work faster and smarter.
 



 ● Process Agility \& Continuous Improvement: You will find ways to fix delays or blockers in the sourcing process so everything runs smoothly and quickly.
 



 ● Client \& Stakeholder Management: You will work closely with the client’s hiring managers, sharing updates regularly, building strong relationships, and making sure we meet their expectations.
 



 ● Quality Assurance: You will check the quality of candidates your team finds to ensure only the best\-vetted profiles are sent to the client.
 



  





 Grade Descriptor
 



 ● Good understanding of procedures and concepts within own discipline and knowledge of these elements in other disciplines.
 



 ● Provides management and operational oversight to large and/or moderately complex business or technical support team members, potentially including work leaders.
 



 ● Sets priorities for the team to ensure task completion; coordinates work activities with other supervisors/team leaders.
 



 ● Responsible for end results of the team.
 



 ● Provides input on resource planning, guidelines, processes and procedures.
 



 ● Solves problems guided by policies and procedures; receives guidance from manager.

description:

 People Manager role handing about 50\-75 HC in a 24 X 7 shift Operations at HYD office. Role involves managing daily Service Levels, driving KPI’s apart from driving continuous improvement process and cost initiatives in the network.
   

  

 The candidate should have a background in Supply chain/ transportation, loss prevention and excellent program management skills. He/she has the ability to pull and analyze data with ease, drive process improvements, standardize our processes and eliminate the root cause of defects within the current systems. This job will require exceptional communication skills while having the ability to work independently in a high\-pressure environment.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

**Responsibilities Include, But Are Not Limited To**
* Continual, tactical communication with external customers (Carriers, Vendors/Suppliers) and internal customers ( Finance, Tech, Fulfillment Centers)
* Ability to pull data from numerous databases (using Excel, Access, SQL and/or other data management systems) and to perform ad hoc reporting and analysis as needed
* Develop Key performance metrics to assist with driving business results.
* Lead initiatives to re\-engineer business processes, and identify and eliminate root causes of defects in order to drive efficiency in Amazon’s transportation operations.
* Must be able to quickly understand the business impact of the trends and make decisions that make sense based on available data.
* Must be able to systematically escalate problems or variance in the information and data to the relevant owners and teams and follow through on the resolutions.
* Work within various time constraints to meet critical business needs.
* Excellent communication, both verbal and written as you will be required to create a narrative outlining your weekly findings and the variances to goals, and present these finding in a review forum.
* Propose improvements to our existing process and utilize AI tools for enhancing productivity


 A day in the life
   

  

 You lead a shift cluster of frontline team managers who keep Amazon's middle\-mile trucking moving in real time. Your day runs on three rhythms that blend from the moment you log in: live operations, people, and mechanisms. You open with a handover from the prior shift and walk the queue of active disruptions — drivers stalled in transit, equipment failures, regulated driving\-hour limits, accidents, and safety escalations. When a team manager needs assistance, you will assess the situation the provide the right guidance or escalate further if needed. In between, you coach — 1:1s, floor\-walks, and live feedback on speed, quality, and customer handling. The rest of your day belongs to mechanisms. You measure what matters — service\-level attainment, resolution time, escalation volume — and own the weekly and monthly business reviews for your scope.
   

  

**About The Team**
 Driver Support Services (DSS) is a dedicated ROC unit that keeps Amazon's most strategic mile capacity moving — Amazon Freight Partner (AFP) carriers and TOMY drivers. AFP is Amazon's committed\-carrier program: contracted partners who operate trucking fleets to Amazon's safety, sustainability, and delivery standards, providing capacity that protects the network from rate volatility and scales with our growth. TOMY drivers are Amazon associates within Transportation Operations Management running shorter\- transit legs where DSS acts as their dispatch. We are a white\-glove dispatch and disruption\-resolution team operating 24x7 across three shift bands.

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
* 3\+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

description:

**Job Summary** 




 The Facilities Operations Manager is responsible for overseeing the overall facilities management, maintenance, safety, and efficiency of facilities operations. The role ensures the smooth functioning of building infrastructure, asset management, vendor services, workplace safety, and operational processes while delivering high service standards and ensuring regulatory compliance.
 



**Package:\- 10\- 11 LPA**

**1\. Operational Management** 



* Oversee daily operations of buildings, grounds, equipment, and facility systems.
* Ensure all facilities operate safely, efficiently, and in compliance with regulatory requirements.
* Manage preventive and corrective maintenance programs.
* Ensure daily facility walkthroughs along with SLs to check and ensure the cleanliness and readiness of the facility at all times.



 2\.

* Ensure 100% uptime for vending machines and preventive maintenance schedules to minimize downtime.
* Maintain accurate asset inventories and maintenance records.
* Manage vendor services, service contracts, warranties, and equipment lifecycle.



 3
 **. Health, Safety \& Compliance** 



* Ensure compliance with all applicable building codes, safety regulations, and company policies.
* Ensure the team is aware of EHS norms and follows them at the site
* Conduct safety audits, risk assessments, and workplace safety training.
* Implement health, safety, and environmental (HSE) protocols.



 4\.
 **Vendor \& Contractor Management** 



* Establish service\-level agreements (SLAs) and ensure adherence to quality standards.
* Conduct vendor performance evaluations and, in case of non\-performance, escalate to JLL management to avoid escalations and ensure client satisfaction at all times.



 5\.
 **Customer Service \& Stakeholder Communication** 



* Act as the primary point of contact for all facility\-related issues.
* Communicate operational updates, outages, and improvement initiatives to stakeholders.
* Ensure prompt response and resolution of service requests to maintain high user satisfaction.



 6\.
 **Emergency \& Risk Management** 



* Manage incident reporting, investigation, and corrective actions.
* Ensure preparedness for emergencies through drills and response protocols.



 7\.
 **Leadership \& Team Management** 



* Supervise, train, and guide facility staff, including Service Leads and housekeeping teams.
* Conduct workforce planning, scheduling, and shift allocation.
* Lead team briefings, feedback sessions, and performance evaluations.
* Promote a culture of safety, accountability, and teamwork.



 8\.
 **Back Office Operations Support** 



* Facilitate employee onboarding, including seating, infrastructure, and workplace readiness.
* Support operational processes, including coordination with HR, finance, and procurement teams.

 **Process Improvement \& Operational Efficiency** 



* Identify gaps in facility operations and implement improvements.
* Introduce best practices for facility management.

 10\.
 **Ticket Monitoring \& Service Management** 



* Monitor and track facility\-related service requests and tickets.
* Coordinate with internal teams and vendors for timely resolution within SLA timelines.

 11\.

* Prepare and present operational performance reports, including:
* Weekly Business Review (WBR)
* Monthly Business Review (MBR)
* Quarterly Business Review (QBR)
* Half\-Yearly Business Review (HBR)

title: Manager II, Program Management, Fee integrity and seller Experience
description:
**Description**
 The Manager II, Program Management role will lead Fee Integrity and Seller Experience Operations within the Seller economics and fees org, responsible for ensuring accurate fee categorization, reducing fee\-related seller contacts, and improving the seller dispute experience across worldwide stores. You will manage a team of product compliance specialists and associates working at the intersection of Fees Product, Science, Tech, Selling Partner Support (SPS), and cross\-functional stakeholder teams to drive execution across key workstreams including fee category override operations, ML model training and evaluation, taxonomy management and seller experience tool readiness.
   

  

 Our environment is fast\-paced and high\-impact: the team processes thousands of fee category override requests monthly, supports ML model training across 20\+ stores, and executes integrity programs protecting tens of millions in annualized fee revenue. This role requires a self\-starter who is detail\-oriented, analytical, and comfortable leading through ambiguity while managing multiple concurrent operational workstreams, cross\-functional dependencies, and senior leadership goals.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced, enthusiastic, and diligent Manager who can drive operational excellence through structured team accountability while partnering across Product, Science, Tech, Finance, Legal, and Seller Support teams. You should understand fee integrity and seller experience problems end\-to\-end, have the ability to identify and mitigate fee accuracy risks before they impact sellers, and scale operations through automation and AI\-driven solutions. As the owner of this domain, you should be able to connect operational execution to business outcomes, translate Director\-level goals into team\-level delivery plans, and build repeatable mechanisms that improve quality, productivity, and seller trust at scale.
   

  

 Key job responsibilities
   

  

* Lead and develop a team of program managers, product compliance specialists and associates ensuring the team delivers high\-quality results that meet business objectives and service\-level commitments.
* Own end\-to\-end execution of fee category override operations, including ticket processing, quality assurance (QA), accuracy monitoring, and SLA management, directly contributing to Director\-level override accuracy goals
* Drive ML labelling operations in partnership with Fees Science, managing base labelling, QA , inconsistency resolution, and timely delivery of training data to support model retraining cycles across store expansions.
* Design and implement automation and GenAI solutions to improve team productivity, reduce manual effort, and eliminate non\-value\-add work across workflows.
* Build and maintain structured quality frameworks across all operational dimensions (override accuracy, ticket accuracy, ML consistency), using data\-driven error analysis, targeted coaching, and SOP standardization
* Partner with Fees Product, Science, Tech, SPS, and Global Financial Audit teams to resolve cross\-functional dependencies, manage escalations, and align on taxonomy updates
* Manage team performance through goal\-setting, balanced scorecards, talent reviews, coaching plans, and structured ramp\-up programs for new hires
* Define and track operational KPIs; build dashboards and reporting mechanisms to provide real\-time visibility into team workload, quality trends, and progress against goals
* Support UAT and SP\-Support readiness for seller experience tools across multiple marketplaces


 A day in the life
   

  

 You start your morning reviewing program metrics and preparing for a team standup where you discuss progress, blockers, and shifting priorities. Mid\-morning might find you in a stakeholder alignment meeting, negotiating trade\-offs between timelines and resources. After lunch, you hold a one\-on\-one with a direct report to discuss their development goals and review a document they are preparing for leadership. Later, you dive into the details of a risk mitigation plan before wrapping up with a quick sync to ensure your team has what they need to move forward.
   

  

**About The Team**
 The Fee Integrity and seller eXperience (FIX) team is Amazon's central program management arm for fee accuracy, seller dispute resolution, and fee\-related seller experience across worldwide marketplaces. Based in Hyderabad, the 25\-member team operates eight interconnected workstreams spanning prevention, detection, correction, and seller education across Amazon's fee ecosystem. FIX partners with Fees Product, Science, Tech, Selling Partner Support, Finance, and Legal teams to drive fee category accuracy, eliminate seller contacts, launch and expand fee integrity products to new marketplaces, and improve how sellers understand and interact with fees.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of team management experience
* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams experience
* 3\+ years of delivering cross functional projects experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements


**Preferred Qualifications**

description:

 Regeneron is founded on the belief that the right idea, combined with the right team, can lead to significant transformations. Our growing global network is dedicated to inventing, developing, and commercializing medicines that change lives for those with serious diseases. In doing so, we are pioneering innovative approaches to science, manufacturing, and commercialization, as well as redefining our understanding of health.
   

  

 At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Manager, Local Lab Delivery to lead the operational delivery, oversight, and continuous improvement of local laboratory reference range data management supporting our clinical development portfolio. In this role, you will oversee the end\-to\-end local laboratory data process, ensuring reference ranges, units, conversion factors, analyse mappings, and associated metadata are accurately interpreted, quality controlled, maintained, and configured within laboratory management systems. You will also lead and develop a team of Local Lab Delivery Specialists and collaborate across Clinical Data Management, Clinical Operations, study teams, technology teams, and external partners.

**Hyderabad (hybrid)**
**Discover Your Role**
* Lead the operational delivery of local laboratory data activities across clinical studies, ensuring timely execution, quality oversight, issue resolution, and effective study support.
* Oversee the intake, interpretation, quality control, maintenance, and delivery of local laboratory reference ranges and metadata, including units, conversion factors, analyse mappings, and study\-specific configurations.
* Ensure accurate and timely configuration, maintenance, and quality oversight of local laboratory information within the EDC Lab Administration system.
* Provide consultation and guidance on study\-specific local laboratory setup requirements, metadata, and complex local laboratory data issues.
* Oversee the maintenance, harmonization, and reuse of local laboratory metadata assets, including analyte libraries, laboratory templates, analyte mappings, units of measure, and reference range information.
* Serve as the escalation point for complex local laboratory data issues and lead root cause analysis, CAPA development, issue resolution, and process remediation activities.
* Partner with Clinical Data Management, Clinical Operations, study teams, system owners, technology teams, laboratory vendors, and external partners to drive successful local laboratory delivery.
* Establish and monitor turnaround times, operational targets, and quality metrics supporting study startup, ongoing data management activities, and database lock achievements.
* Ensure local laboratory data processes, systems, and documentation comply with SOPs, work instructions, quality standards, GxP requirements, and inspection\-readiness expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement and technology enablement, including opportunities involving automation, AI\-enabled solutions, document extraction, unit harmonization, metadata classification, test synonym mapping, and quality review.
* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Local Lab Delivery Specialists while managing performance objectives, development plans, workload allocation, resource planning, and operational priorities.


**This Role Requires**
* Bachelor’s degree in Science, Health, Data Management, Mathematics, Computing, or a related field.
* 7\+ years of Clinical Data Management experience within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, CRO, or healthcare environments.
* 5\+ years of direct Local Laboratory Delivery experience and 2\+ years of people management experience.
* Advanced knowledge of local laboratory reference range management, including analyte interpretation, unit conversions, conversion algorithms, test synonym mapping, reference range evaluation, and metadata management.
* Strong understanding of local laboratory data collection, validation, maintenance, quality control, and delivery processes supporting Clinical Data Management.
* Strong knowledge of clinical trial processes, Clinical Data Management principles, EDC systems, laboratory administration systems, and related clinical data technologies.
* Experience managing complex laboratory data issues through root cause analysis, CAPA development, issue resolution, and process remediation.
* Knowledge of applicable regulations, GxP requirements, clinical data quality principles, SOPs, and inspection\-readiness expectations.
* Demonstrated experience with operational metrics, targets, turnaround times, quality indicators, process improvement, and operational excellence.
* Strong leadership and people\-management capabilities, including coaching, mentoring, performance management, resource planning, and staff development.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, decision\-making, stakeholder management, and cross\-functional collaboration skills.
* Exposure to automation, AI\-enabled solutions, workflow optimization, metadata management, or digital transformation within laboratory data management is preferred.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* May require up to 25% travel

title: Manager / Senior Manager – Supply Chain & Raw Materials
description:
Raghu Vamsi Aerospace, Hyderabad is part of the Raghu Vamsi Group, a precision aerospace and industrial machining organisation. The Group manufactures complex, close\-tolerance components for global OEMs and Tier\-1 customers across Aerospace, Oil \& Gas and Industrial sectors.
 



**Role Purpose** 




 The Manager / Senior Manager – Supply Chain \& Raw Materials will be responsible for ensuring reliable, cost\-effective and compliant sourcing of raw materials, tools and consumables – with particular criticality around specialty materials used in aerospace\-grade manufacturing – in support of production schedules across the Aerospace, Oil \& Gas and Industrial businesses. The role calls for strong material and market knowledge, sharp negotiation ability and the maturity to operate in a fast\-paced, precision\-manufacturing environment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end planning and procurement of raw materials, cutting tools and consumables required for aerospace, oil \& gas and industrial production programs.
* Take particular ownership of specialty and critical materials – ensuring uninterrupted, compliant supply given their long lead times and criticality to production.
* Develop and manage a robust, qualified supplier base across raw materials, tooling and consumables, ensuring adherence to certifications, traceability and industry/customer specifications.
* Partner with Planning, Engineering, Quality and Production teams to translate production schedules into accurate material and tooling requirement plans, avoiding stock\-outs and minimising excess/obsolete inventory.
* Lead sourcing strategy for critical and long\-lead\-time items, including dual\-sourcing, forward buying and risk mitigation for supply volatility (price, availability, market constraints).
* Negotiate pricing, contracts and long\-term supply agreements with mills, distributors, tooling vendors and service centres to secure cost, quality and delivery commitments.
* Ensure all incoming material and tooling is accompanied by correct certification and drive compliance with AS9100 / NADCAP and customer quality requirements.
* Monitor and report on cost trends, lead times, supplier performance (OTIF, quality, responsiveness) and inventory health; drive corrective actions where required.
* Identify and implement cost\-reduction and value\-engineering opportunities in sourcing without compromising quality or delivery.
* Build contingency and business\-continuity plans for critical material and tooling supply, including alternate sources and safety stock strategies.
* Mentor and develop a small team of buyers/planners; instil discipline in forecasting, PO management and supplier governance.



**Candidate Profile** 



* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or equivalent; a specific specialisation is not essential – strong, relevant industry experience matters more than the degree stream.
* 12–18 years of experience in raw material / tooling \& consumables sourcing and supply chain management, with a significant portion in aerospace, defence, oil \& gas or other precision/regulated manufacturing environments.
* Strong, demonstrable working knowledge of specialty materials used in aerospace\-grade manufacturing, along with raw materials, cutting tools and consumables more broadly – including sourcing markets, forms and certification requirements.
* Prior exposure to similar industries – aerospace component manufacturing, oil \& gas equipment, or other precision engineering sectors – with an established supplier network.
* Sound understanding of AS9100, NADCAP and customer\-specific material and quality requirements; experience with material traceability and certification management.
* Sharp, proven negotiation skills and experience managing supplier contracts, long\-term agreements and price/lead\-time risk.
* Smart, sharp and commercially astute, with strong analytical and planning capability; comfortable working with ERP/MRP systems and data\-driven decision\-making.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work cross\-functionally with Planning, Engineering, Quality, Production and Finance.
* High personal integrity, ownership and a proactive, hands\-on approach suited to a growing, high\-precision manufacturing environment.



**What the Role Offers** 




 The opportunity to build and shape a critical supply chain function for a fast\-growing aerospace and precision manufacturing group, working closely with senior leadership and gaining exposure across the Aerospace, Oil \& Gas and Industrial businesses.

 The Product \& Technology Group (PTG) at Blackbaud is seeking a strategic, forward\-thinking leader to join our Portfolio Management Office (PMO), where you will work with a passionate team responsible for optimally managing a diverse and complex portfolio.
