title: Event Management Specialist
description:
**Position Title:** 
 EMT Lead – Event Management Technology
 **\| Experience Required:** 
 7–8 Years
 



**Function:** 
 IT Operations / Technical Operations Center (TOC)
 **\| Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time
 



**Role Summary** 




 We are seeking an experienced Event Management Technology (EMT) Lead to own the enterprise event management platform and strategy — correlating, filtering, and prioritizing events generated across monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, SolarWinds, and VeloCloud into meaningful, actionable alerts. This role sits at the intersection of monitoring, automation, and incident response, and is responsible for reducing alert noise, improving signal\-to\-noise ratio, and ensuring the right events reach the right teams at the right time within a 24x7 TOC environment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Event Management Platform Ownership** 



* Own the enterprise event management/correlation platform, integrating event feeds from Dynatrace, SolarWinds, VeloCloud, and other monitoring/observability tools.
* Design and maintain event correlation rules, deduplication logic, suppression policies, and event enrichment to reduce alert fatigue and noise.
* Define event severity/priority frameworks aligned with business impact and service criticality.
* Continuously tune event thresholds and correlation logic based on incident trends and false\-positive analysis.



**Team Leadership \& TOC Operations** 



* Lead and mentor a team of event/monitoring engineers operating in a 24x7 TOC, ensuring consistent shift coverage and escalation discipline.
* Own the event\-to\-incident lifecycle — ensuring critical events are correctly triaged, escalated, and routed to the right resolver groups.
* Drive shift handovers, ticket hygiene, and documentation standards across the team.
* Conduct performance reviews, skills assessments, and training for team members on event management tools and processes.



**Integration \& Automation** 



* Integrate the event management platform with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Remedy, Jira Service Management) for automated incident/ticket creation.
* Drive auto\-remediation and self\-healing workflows for known, recurring event patterns.
* Partner with monitoring tool owners (Dynatrace, SolarWinds, VeloCloud admins) to ensure clean, well\-structured event data feeds into the platform.
* Support AIOps initiatives — anomaly detection, event clustering, and predictive alerting — to mature the event management capability.



**Incident \& Problem Management** 



* Act as an escalation point during major incidents (P1/P2\), ensuring rapid event\-to\-response handoff to Incident Management.
* Drive RCA for event storms, missed escalations, or correlation failures, and implement preventive improvements.
* Partner with Incident/Problem Management to reduce MTTD (Mean Time to Detect) and MTTA (Mean Time to Acknowledge).



**Reporting \& Stakeholder Management** 



* Build dashboards and reports on event volumes, noise reduction metrics, correlation effectiveness, and escalation SLAs.
* Present regular updates to IT leadership on event management maturity, trends, and improvement roadmap.
* Collaborate with Network, Infrastructure, Application, and Security teams to align event priorities with business\-critical services.



**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* 7–8 years of overall IT experience, with at least 3–4 years focused on event management, monitoring, or TOC leadership.
* Strong hands\-on experience with event/alert data from Dynatrace, SolarWinds, and VeloCloud.
* Experience with event management/correlation platforms (e.g., ServiceNow Event Management, BMC TrueSight, Moogsoft, PagerDuty, xMatters, or similar).
* Solid understanding of ITSM processes (Incident, Problem, Change Management) and event\-to\-ticket workflows.
* Experience working in a 24x7 TOC/NOC environment, including shift management and major incident escalation.
* Proven ability to design correlation rules, suppression logic, and severity frameworks to reduce alert noise.
* Team leadership experience (managing 5\+ engineers) in an operations environment.
* Strong stakeholder communication skills, with experience presenting to senior IT leadership.



**Good to Have** 



* Exposure to AIOps platforms and machine\-learning\-based event correlation.
* Scripting/automation experience (Python, PowerShell) for event pipeline customization.
* Familiarity with cloud\-native monitoring/event sources (Azure Monitor, AWS CloudWatch).
* Relevant certifications (ITIL Foundation, Dynatrace, ServiceNow Event Management).



**Education** 



* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (or equivalent practical experience).

title: Manager, Third Party Strategy and Oversight
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose\-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
   

  

**Position Summary**
 The Manager, Third Party Strategy and Oversight (TPSO) supports the operational execution of third‑party oversight activities within Patient Safety (PS). This role is responsible for monitoring performance, maintaining oversight metrics, supporting compliance activities, and contributing to continuous improvement of outsourced pharmacovigilance (PV) activities.
   

  

 The role works closely with TPSO leadership and cross‑functional stakeholders to ensure third parties operate in compliance with global PV regulations, GVP requirements, BMS quality standards, and contractual obligations. The role is primarily execution‑focused, providing data, analysis, documentation, and recommendations to support effective governance and decision‑making.
   

  

**Duties/Responsibilities**
 Third‑Party Oversight \& Monitoring
   

  

* Perform day‑to‑day management and oversight activities for assigned third‑party vendors, distributors, or business partners performing PV‑related activities.
* Collect, track, and maintain third‑party performance data, KPIs, and quality metrics in accordance with established oversight processes.
* Review metrics and reports for completeness, accuracy, and trends; flag potential risks or compliance concerns for escalation and proactively recommend mitigation and improvement/corrective actions to PS teams.
* Support investigation and documentation of compliance issues, including deviations, root cause analysis inputs, and CAPA tracking.


 Compliance, Quality \& Inspection Readiness
   

  

* Support audit and inspection readiness activities related to third‑party oversight, including document preparation, evidence collection, and response tracking.
* Assist in the review of safety agreements (e.g., PVAs, SOWs) to ensure oversight requirements are addressed and understood.
* Maintain accurate and inspection‑ready records supporting third‑party oversight activities.


 Stakeholder Collaboration \& Communication
   

  

* Work collaboratively with BMS stakeholders to resolve third‑party issues in a timely manner.
* Prepare oversight inputs, summaries, and data for governance forums and management reviews.
* Communicate clearly and professionally with internal stakeholders and external partners within defined role scope.
* Support projects that build strategic third\-party oversight capabilities, processes and standards to ensure delivery of PS objectives.
* Contribute to the development of standard operating procedures and training relating to core responsibilities as needed.


 Culture \& Ways of Working
   

  

* Demonstrate a strong quality mindset and promote a culture of quality and compliance, accountability, transparency, and continuous improvement.
* Contribute positively to a collaborative and inclusive team environment.
* Support broader SQM initiatives and book of work, as assigned.


 This role reports to: Head of Third\-Party Oversight and Strategy
   

  

**Qualifications**
 Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Nursing, Public Health, or a related discipline.
* 4–7 years of experience in Pharmacovigilance, Safety Operations, Quality, or a related pharmaceutical function.
* Experience supporting vendor or third‑party oversight activities in a regulated environment.
* Working knowledge of global PV regulations, GxP principles, and quality system expectations.
* Experience working with performance metrics, KPIs, compliance tracking, or quality indicators; ability to interpret complex data and translate it into actionable insights.
* Strong attention to detail, organisational skills, project management and ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
* Ability to analyse data, identify issues or trends, and escalate appropriately.
* Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate in a matrixed environment.
* Demonstrates integrity, sound judgement, and commitment to quality and compliance.


 We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

 Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site\-essential, site\-by\-design, field\-based and remote\-by\-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. description:

 **Hyderabad, Telangana, India; Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India** 
 .
 **Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience identifying process issues or working with cross\-functional teams.
* 5 years of experience with contact center metrics and QA methodologies.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience with LLM\-based evaluation frameworks and prompt engineering.
* Experience in stratified sampling to identify specific interactions for human validation, ensuring that human efforts are focused on high\-signal or ambiguous cases.
* Familiarity with QA automation and sampling tools.


**About the job** 
 A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Program Manager at Google, you’ll lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish — working with stakeholders to plan requirements, manage project schedules, identify risks, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. Your projects will often span offices, time zones, and hemispheres. It's your job to coordinate the players and keep them up to date on progress and deadlines.
   

  

 The YouTube Global Vendor Operations team develops practical ways to address some of the most complex business issues to keep YouTube growing. We anticipate how decisions are made, persistently explore and uncover the business needs of our key clients, and understand how our range of product and service offerings can enable their business success.
   

  

 We lead the global vendor quality program which enables our suppliers to deliver amazing experiences for YouTube’s consumers, creators and partners.
   

  

**Responsibilities**

 **Chief Operating Officer**

The COO reports directly to the Managing Director and partners closely with the senior leadership team to translate business strategy into execution and build scalable operating models supporting the company’s next phase of growth.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Lead the growth and operational performance of the Gold Loan business across the branch network.

* Oversee the end\-to\-end Gold Loan lifecycle including sourcing, appraisal, LTV, credit, documentation, disbursement, custody, release, and auction.
* Strengthen processes, controls, turnaround time, and customer experience.
* Lead branch, regional, and field operations across geographies.
* Drive business targets, productivity, operational efficiency, and cost optimisation.
* Monitor branch and regional performance and implement corrective actions.
* Support branch expansion and scalable operating models.
* Oversee portfolio performance, collections, and recovery operations.
* Monitor AUM, delinquency, collection efficiency, and asset quality.
* Strengthen recovery and auction processes ensuring compliance with regulatory and internal requirements.
* Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, and Legal to strengthen the control environment.
* Ensure adherence to RBI regulations and internal policies.
* Drive process standardisation, automation, and technology\-led improvements to improve turnaround time, productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Establish effective MIS and dashboards for business and operational monitoring.
* Lead and mentor senior business, regional, and operations teams, building a strong culture of performance and accountability.
* Partner with the MD/CEO on business strategy, expansion, and organisational priorities.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with Credit, Risk, Finance, HR, Technology, Compliance, and Legal teams.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Education: Postgraduate degree in Management, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline.
* Experience: 15\+ years in NBFCs, banking, or financial services with strong and demonstrable experience in the Gold Loan business.
* Leadership: Proven experience as COO, Business Head, Operations Head, National Operations Head, or equivalent, managing large branch and field operations across multiple geographies.
* Technical Expertise: Deep understanding of the end\-to\-end Gold Loan lifecycle, secured lending operations, RBI regulations, operational risk, internal controls, and governance.
* Soft Skills: Strong leadership, strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and ability to drive growth while maintaining portfolio quality and operational discipline.
* Proficiency in Telugu is mandatory.


 Why Consider this Opportunity?
   

  

* Lead the strategic scaling of a core Gold Loan business within a growing NBFC platform.
* Drive operational excellence and portfolio quality across a multi\-state branch network.
* Shape scalable operating models and technology\-led process improvements.
* Partner directly with the Managing Director and senior leadership on business strategy and expansion.
* Influence risk, compliance, and governance frameworks in a regulated financial services environment.

title: Head of SOX Testing
description:
**Company Description** 




 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
 



**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.** 




 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
 



 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
 



**For everyone, everywhere.** 




  





 More about
 **our mission**
 and
 **what we offer**
 .
 



  





**Job Description** 




**About the team (Finance Risk \& Control)** 




 Finance Risk \& Control partners with Finance and the wider business to strengthen the control environment, support SOX compliance, and improve how risks and controls are designed, operated and evidenced. We’re a distributed team across the UK and Estonia, and we’re building a SOX testing hub in Hyderabad to increase consistency, quality and scalability of our testing programme.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing (responsibilities)** 




 Own the SOX business process controls testing programme (end\-to\-end)
 


* Build and run the annual and interim testing plan across all in\-scope business process controls.
* Plan when testing occurs and ensure sequencing reflects process dependencies, change activity, and auditor timelines.
* Deliver both Design Effectiveness and Operating Effectiveness testing to a consistently high standard.



 Methodology, quality, and audit readiness
 


* Own and continuously improve the testing methodology, templates, sampling guidance, and evidence standards.
* Perform QA reviews to ensure testing is complete, well\-documented, and auditor\-ready.
* Ensure consistent conclusions and a strong “why” behind pass/fail outcomes.



 Auditor partnership and external reporting
 


* Be a key interface for the external auditor on business process testing: align approach, share results, coordinate walkthroughs/re\-performance support, and respond to questions efficiently.
* Present testing outcomes clearly in governance packs and formal forums.



 Manage external resources / co\-sourcing
 


* Manage external testing resources: onboarding to Wise methodology, allocation, progress tracking, and quality/performance oversight.
* Ensure external capacity reduces bottlenecks without creating rework or inconsistencies.



 Issue management and remediation governance
 


* Oversee how issues are agreed (severity, impact, root cause) and ensure remediation plans are practical, measurable, and owned.
* Track progress and coordinate re\-testing / closure requirements.



 Minimise burden on the business
 


* Build a low\-friction evidence request process and smart scheduling to reduce disruption for process owners.
* Drive clarity and predictability: stakeholders know what’s needed, when, and why.



 Build the Hyderabad testing capability
 


* This is the first testing hire in Hyderabad; you’ll help build the operating model and then hire/lead a team of 6\+ testers.
* Coach and develop the team; embed standards, consistency, and stakeholder partnership.
* Integrate day\-to\-day delivery with the UK/Estonia Finance Risk \& Control team.



 Innovation: AI/data\-enabled testing in BAU
 


* Identify opportunities to use AI and analytics to improve coverage, speed, and quality (e.g., evidence extraction, population testing, exception flagging).
* Implement in a controlled, explainable way that auditors and internal stakeholders can rely on.



 Themes, insights, and SOX capability\-building
 


* Identify trends across testing results and recommend improvements (control design, execution, monitoring, evidence).
* Help build SOX understanding across the business through guidance, coaching and practical support.



  





**Qualifications** 




**What you’ll bring (requirements)** 




 Essential
 


* Strong SOX/ICFR testing experience across business process controls (DE \+ OE).
* Deep understanding of controls testing methodology, sampling, evidence expectations, and audit standards.
* Proven experience running a testing programme end\-to\-end (planning → fieldwork → QA → issues → reporting).
* Experience managing/coordinating co\-sourced or external testing teams and driving quality.
* Strong stakeholder management and ability to influence remediation outcomes.
* Excellent written documentation skills and governance\-ready communication.



 Nice to have
 


* Experience building/scaling a testing function or controls centre of excellence.
* Fintech/high\-growth/regulated environment experience.
* Experience with continuous controls monitoring, data analytics, or AI\-enabled assurance/testing.
* Experience working across time zones and distributed teams.



 How we work / Level 7 expectations
 


* Sets direction for a programme area and raises the bar for quality and consistency.
* Operates independently, makes sound risk\-based judgments, and escalates early with options.
* Balances rigour with pragmatism—delivers SOX compliance without unnecessary complexity.
* Builds trusted relationships across Finance and the business.



  





 Key stakeholders
 



 Process Owners, Control Owners, Finance teams, Tech/data partners (as needed for automation), External auditors, UK \& Estonia Finance Risk \& Control.
 



  





**Additional Information** 




 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
 



 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
 



 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

title: Head of Agency Lending Operations, Managing Director
description:
**Who Are We Looking For**
 We are looking for an industry leader with hands\-on experience in Agency Lending Operations within a Markets business. You understand what great looks like in a global operations organization and bring deep knowledge of the functions that support Agency Lending across the trade lifecycle. You combine strong operational expertise with executive presence, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, and a proven ability to influence, lead through change, and navigate complex challenges.
   

  

 This is a key leadership role responsible for overseeing a global team of approximately 150 professionals across India, Hong Kong, London, and Boston, providing operational support for Agency Lending activities, including settlement, reconciliations, and collateral management. You will lead the organization through the complexity of a large\-scale global operation, ensuring accurate trade processing, effective collateralization, robust risk management, regulatory compliance, and seamless day\-to\-day execution.
   

  

 You will work closely with business, technology, risk, and control partners to drive innovation across processes and systems, enhancing efficiency, scalability, and risk management while ensuring operational solutions remain aligned with State Street's strategic objectives, industry best practices, and evolving market needs.
   

  

 A significant part of your mandate will be the transformation of the function. You will have the opportunity to help shape the future operating model, modernize the technology infrastructure, and drive initiatives that reduce risk, improve efficiency, and accelerate speed to market. Success in this role will require balancing long\-term transformation with an unwavering focus on day\-to\-day execution and client service.
   

  

 The role can be based in Mumbai, Bangalore, or Hyderabad and reports directly to the SVP, Global Head of Financing and Portfolio Solutions Operations.
   

  

**Why this role is important to us**
 The team you will be joining is a part of State Street Markets (SSM). As a leading provider of trading and lending solutions to the world’s institutional investors, we deliver the industry’s most innovative platforms, financing and portfolio solutions. Our capabilities are backed by proprietary, high\-value research, insights and indicators that power clients’ investment decisions, accelerate performance and help investors stay ahead of shifting markets. Across our comprehensive set of solutions – data\-driven macro market intelligence that give an information advantage; client\-first platforms and tools that redefine trading; financing solutions that streamline liquidity access; and portfolio solutions designed to help achieve peak performance – we deliver a breakthrough edge to drive business success.
   

  

 As one of the largest and most experienced providers of financing and portfolio solutions in the industry, we provide investors with market\-leading expertise, technology and scale to accelerate decision making, enhance performance and unlock efficiencies across the entire trade lifecycle.
   

  

 We are in the midst of a significant transformation as we modernize our technology architecture and transition from legacy platforms to a more scalable, future\-state environment. The processes and functions that support our Agency Lending business are critical to the success of State Street Markets and operate at significant scale and complexity. This transformation presents a unique opportunity to help redesign and optimize key workflows, driving greater automation, efficiency and resiliency across the business. As one of the largest businesses within Markets, and one of the world's leading agent lenders, we provide the scale, visibility and impact to shape the future of a market\-leading franchise.
   

  

 Join us if making your mark in the capital markets industry from day one is a challenge you are up for.
   

  

**What You Will Be Responsible For**
 As Head of Agency Lending Operations, Managing Director, you will:
   

  

* Lead a global organization of 150\+ professionals, driving consistent service delivery, robust governance and controls, operational resilience, and a culture of excellence across regions while setting the strategic direction for one of the industry's leading Agency Lending operations teams.
* Own the end\-to\-end Agency Lending operating platform, overseeing trade capture, confirmations, settlement, clearing, reconciliation, cash movements, data management, and lifecycle events across loan and return activity, as well as bilateral and triparty transactions.
* Provide strategic leadership across the Agency Lending collateral ecosystem, overseeing margin management, bilateral and triparty collateralization, dispute resolution, collateral sufficiency monitoring, and optimization throughout the lending lifecycle, including collateral impacts arising from corporate actions.
* Shape the future of Agency Lending Operations by leading a significant transformation and modernization agenda. Partnering closely with Technology, Business, and Risk teams, you will help deliver scalable, automated future\-state capabilities while optimizing the operating model and cost base to support growth, efficiency, and global consistency.
* Champion a best\-in\-class risk and control environment, proactively identifying and mitigating operational, settlement, and counterparty risks, strengthening controls and operational resilience, and ensuring timely and effective management of incidents, remediation activities, and escalations.
* Ensure the organization remains audit\-ready and regulatory compliant, maintaining adherence to applicable regulations, internal policies, and industry standards while overseeing regulatory reporting, data governance, model risk requirements, and readiness for an evolving regulatory landscape.
* Serve as a trusted partner to senior stakeholders and key market participants, leading relationships across Front Office, Custody, Risk/ERM, Compliance, Technology, counterparties, borrowers, custodians, clearing agents, and strategic vendors. You will act as a senior escalation point, helping ensure exceptional service delivery, strong cyber\-risk oversight, and swift resolution of complex operational issues.
* Build and inspire a high\-performing global leadership team, attracting, developing, and retaining exceptional talent while strengthening succession planning, leadership depth, and an inclusive culture that enables individuals and teams to perform at their best.


**Education \& Preferred Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, or related field is preferred. A postgraduate/professional qualification is advantageous
* 20\+ years of experience in financial services operations, with focus on Agency Lending
* Strong understanding of Agency Lending products and processes (e.g., trade lifecycle management/settlement/collateral, triparty agents, vendors)
* Proven track record of strengthening risk and control environments and managing regulatory and operational risk.
* Experience leading transformation initiatives, including process optimization, automation, and technology modernization.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective partnerships across business, operations, technology, and corporate functions.
* Strategic thinker with a proven change management mindset and experience driving large\-scale initiatives.


**About State Street**
 Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
   

  

 We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work\-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.
   

  

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

 Most marketplace roles eventually become coordination roles.
 



 Listings get uploaded, campaigns go live, sales happen — but very few people truly think about how catalogue quality, platform visibility, and operational execution directly impact long\-term revenue growth.
 



 At SkinBae, we are building this differently.
 



 We are looking for someone who naturally thinks about:
 


* how brands scale across marketplaces
* how listings influence conversion and discoverability
* how marketplace growth and operations connect together
* how systems can be built to reduce errors and improve efficiency at scale



 This role is not just about managing listings or operations. It is about building scalable marketplace growth engines across multiple Korean beauty brands.

 SkinBae is building a curated Korean skincare platform in India. We work closely with global Korean beauty brands and focus on education\-led storytelling, strong visual identity, and long\-term brand building across D2C, marketplaces, and offline retail.

* Coach and develop team members to maximise performance, capability, and career growth.
* Recruit, onboard, and retain top talent.

* Drive actions that improve customer satisfaction, strengthen customer confidence in Keyloop, and support long\-term customer retention.


**Drive Operational Excellence**
* Ensure service levels, quality standards, and key performance indicators are achieved.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through analysis of support performance data.
* Implement improvements that increase efficiency and reduce customer effort.


**Influence Across the Business**
* Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success teams to resolve systemic issues and improve the customer experience.
* Use customer and operational insights to influence product direction and business priorities.
* Contribute to the strategic development of support within the Korean market.


**Skills, Knowledge And Experience**
* Proven experience leading and developing high\-performing teams.
* Previous experience in a customer\-focused, support, service delivery, or technical support environment.
* Demonstrated ability to drive change, lead continuous improvement initiatives, and influence positive outcomes.
* Strong customer relationship management and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience handling escalations and managing complex customer situations.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to make data\-driven decisions.
* Experience using reporting, metrics, and insights to improve operational performance.
* Confidence using AI\-powered tools and technology to identify trends, improve efficiency, and drive better customer outcomes.
* Ability to work collaboratively across multiple business functions, including Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success.
* Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills.
* A proactive mindset with a focus on accountability, ownership, and delivering results.


**Qualifications Required**
* Fluent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Previous experience leading a team in a customer\-facing environment.
* Experience within a software support, technical support, service delivery, or customer operations role is desirable.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and business productivity tools.
* Experience working with customer support or case management systems is advantageous.
* Degree\-level qualification or equivalent professional experience preferred.

 We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space \- and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. Work with game\-changing products and services. Get the training and support you need to try new things, adapt to quick changes and explore different paths. Join Keyloop and progress your career, your way.
   

  

**An inclusive environment to thrive**
 We’re committed to fostering an inclusive work environment. One that respects all dimensions of diversity. We promote an inclusive culture within our business, and we celebrate different employees and lifestyles \- not just on key days, but every day.
   

  

**Be rewarded for your efforts**
 We believe people should be paid based on their performance so our pay and benefits reflect this and are designed to attract the very best talent. We encourage everyone in our organisation to explore opportunities which enable them to grow their career through investment in their development but equally by working in a culture which fosters support and unbridled collaboration.

title: Diamond Jewelry Retail : Store Manager
description:
**Company Description** 




 House of Quadri is a contemporary lab\-grown diamond jewelry brand based in Mumbai, India. The company designs, manufactures, and directly retails its jewelry, maintaining close control over quality and craftsmanship. As a small, dynamic team, House of Quadri is building a direct\-to\-consumer brand with an online\-first approach. Team members work in an environment that values innovation, modern aesthetics, and customer\-centric thinking. The company offers opportunities to contribute to a growing brand at the intersection of jewelry, fashion, and technology.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 The Store Manager role is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Banjara Hills, Hyderabad. The Store Manager will oversee daily store operations, including opening and closing procedures, visual merchandising, inventory management, and coordination with the production and online teams. This role involves leading and training store staff, ensuring high standards of customer service, and maintaining a welcoming, brand\-aligned store environment.
 



  





 The Store Manager will manage sales targets, track performance, handle customer inquiries and escalations, and support in\-store events or promotions. The role also includes monitoring product quality, coordinating quality checks/repairs as needed, and providing feedback to design and manufacturing teams to enhance the customer experience.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess skills in diamond jewelry product and an understanding of pricing ind detail.
* Candidates should possess strong customer service skills, including client engagement, relationship\-building, and after\-sales support.
* Candidates should possess knowledge of basic jewelry finishing standards to ensure product quality on the sales floor.
* Candidates should possess training and team leadership skills to coach staff, conduct product and service trainings, and maintain performance standards.
* Relevant experience in retail store management, preferably in jewelry, luxury, or fashion, is highly beneficial.
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to work in a collaborative environment.
* Comfort with digital tools, CRM, POS systems, and coordination with online sales or e\-commerce channels.
* A diploma or degree in retail management, business, fashion, or a related field is an advantage.

title: Fund Services Assistant Manager
description:
**About Us**
 As a world leading provider of integrated solutions for the alternative investment industry, Alter Domus (meaning “The Other House” in Latin) is proud to be home to 90% of the top 30 asset managers in the private markets, and more than 6,000 professionals across 24 jurisdictions.
   

  

 With a deep understanding of what it takes to succeed in alternatives, we believe in being different \- in what we do, in how we work and most importantly in how we enable and develop our people. Invest yourself in the alternative, and join an organization where you progress on merit, where you can speak openly with whoever you are speaking to, and where you will be supported along whichever path you choose to take.
   

  

 Find out more about life at Alter Domus at careers.alterdomus.com
   

  

**Your Responsibilities**
 As a member of the Private Equity team, you will be accountable for an efficient processing and review of end\-to\-end PE funds NAV delivery, including capital events, annual financials, support year end audit process and specifically supports the team during process migration to India CDC and overseeing the NAV delivery:
   

  

* Supervise and mentor a team of Fund Accountants and Senior Fund Accountants, ensuring strong technical capability and client service orientation
* Oversee quarterly and annual financial statements under US GAAP/IFRS, including partner capital accounts and waterfall allocations.
* Review and approve capital activity (calls, distributions, equalizations) and ensure compliance with side letters and bespoke investor economics
* Implement and monitor internal controls for an efficient NAV accounting process and exception management to maintain audit readiness
* Identify and execute process improvements to reduce cycle times and enhance reporting accuracy
* Support system optimization initiatives (Investran, Allvue, and other Nav accounting tools) and other NAV process automation projects
* Sign off as reviewer on SOC1 checklist and support SOC external audit requests
* Ensure compliance with internal audit procedures and requests
* Develop leadership skills by demonstrating willingness to lead projects and offer input; and
* Demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of the governing agreement(s) between Alter Domus, the clients and their investors
* Foster a culture of accountability, responsiveness, and continuous improvement.


**YOUR PROFILE**
* Bachelor’s/master’s degree in accounting, Finance, any other professional accounting qualification (i.e. CA, CMA or ACCA or equivalent)
* Minimum of 10\+ years’ experience in accounting for the financial services sector, particularly Private Equity, Asset Management or Fund Administration.
* Supervisory skills with experience in managing and/or leading staff for 3\-4 years and should have conducted minimum 1 performance appraisal cycle for junior staff
* Private equity fund experience, Exposure to complex fund structures
* Expertise in US GAAP/IFRS, waterfall mechanics, carried interest, and investor economics.
* Familiarity with PE accounting platforms (Investran, Allvue) is highly preferred
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
* Ability to perform multiple projects, navigate unexpected challenges, and bring about viable solutions that provide the best results.


**What We Offer**
 We are committed to supporting your development, advancing your career, and providing benefits that matter to you.
   

  

 Our industry\-leading Alter Domus Academy offers six learning zones for every stage of your career, with resources tailored to your ambitions and resources from LinkedIn Learning.
   

  

**Our Global Benefits Also Include**
* Support for professional accreditations such as ACCA and study leave
* Flexible arrangements, generous holidays, plus an additional day off for your birthday!
* Continuous mentoring along your career progression
* Active sports, events and social committees across our offices
* 24/7 support available from our Employee Assistance Program
* The opportunity to invest in our growth and success through our Employee Share Plan
* Plus additional local benefits depending on your location


 Alter Domus is an Equal Opportunity Employer: Equity Statement
   

  

 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.
   

  

 (Alter Domus Privacy notice can be reviewed via Alter Domus webpage: https://alterdomus.com/privacy\-notice/)

title: Quality Manager IRC298730
description:
**Description**
 GlobalLogic is looking for a detail\-oriented Quality Management professional with strong expertise in quality assurance, audit frameworks, performance management, and continuous improvement. The ideal candidate will be responsible for governing quality standards, monitoring operational performance, driving corrective actions, and ensuring consistent quality delivery across service operations.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Quality Management, or a related field.
* Proven experience in quality management, quality assurance, or operational excellence within a service industry.
* Experience managing quality performance.
* Strong knowledge of quality management systems, audit methodologies, and root cause analysis techniques.
* Proficiency in analyzing quality metrics, identifying trends, and driving improvement initiatives.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Experience leading and developing quality teams.
* Strong problem\-solving, decision\-making, and project management capabilities.
* Proficiency in reporting tools and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally and influence operational teams to achieve quality objectives.


 Job responsibilities
   

  

  

* Define and govern quality standards, processes, and audit frameworks for quality operations.
* Monitor quality performance through audits, scorecards, and key quality metrics.
* Identify quality risks, analyze error trends, and drive root cause analysis and corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with client requirements, operational procedures, and contractual quality commitments.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives to reduce defects and enhance overall quality performance.
* Drive training, calibration, and capability\-building programs based on quality findings.
* Provide regular quality reporting and insights to operational and client stakeholders.
* Manage and develop the quality team to ensure consistent and effective quality oversight.
* Work closely with internal and external stakeholders on deliverables.
* Prepare and present reports on quality metrics, performance, and improvement initiatives.


 What we offer
   

  

**Exciting Projects:** 
 We focus on industries like High\-Tech, communication, media, healthcare, retail and telecom. Our customer list is full of fantastic global brands and leaders who love what we build for them.
   

  

**Collaborative Environment:** 
 You Can expand your skills by collaborating with a diverse team of highly talented people in an open, laidback environment — or even abroad in one of our global centers or client facilities!
   

  

**Work\-Life Balance:** 
 GlobalLogic prioritizes work\-life balance, which is why we offer flexible work schedules, opportunities to work from home, and paid time off and holidays.
   

  

**Professional Development:** 
 Our dedicated Learning \& Development team regularly organizes Communication skills training(GL Vantage, Toast Master),Stress Management program, professional certifications, and technical and soft skill trainings.
   

  

**Excellent Benefits:**

title: Manager - Direct and FC&L Procurement
description:
**Build Our Future Together**
 At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life\-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We are seeking a Manager, Direct Materials Procurement to join our Global Procurement team, supporting our India operations in a hybrid work model. In this role, you will drive category strategy, sourcing, and supplier performance for direct materials while collaborating with cross\-functional partners and global procurement colleagues. This position offers the opportunity to contribute to a fast\-growing, science\-driven organization making a meaningful difference to patients worldwide.
   

  

**When \& Where**
 Hyderabad, India (Hybrid)
   

  

**Discover Your Role**
* Drive the definition and implementation of global direct material category strategies aligned to regional and global business needs
* Partner with collaborators to manage category priorities, sourcing decisions, and procurement activities across direct materials
* Lead negotiations, contracting, and supplier management to deliver cost savings, cash flow improvements, and operational efficiencies
* Ensure category activities align with GxP and applicable regulatory standards
* Collaborate with Legal to negotiate contract terms and conditions aligned to business requirements
* Use market intelligence, supplier insights, and data analytics to inform decision\-making and improve category performance
* Contribute to organizational decisions and initiatives that shape global procurement capabilities and category outcomes
* You operate effectively in a matrixed, global environment and build strong, trusted relationships with internal and external partners.


**This Role Requires**

* Proven experience managing category strategies, sourcing, contracting, and supplier relationships across direct materials or related categories.
* Strong negotiation capability with understanding of cost structures, rates, and supply market dynamics.
* Demonstrated success working with cross\-functional teams to deliver results across procurement activities.
* Experience supporting supplier evaluation processes using market intelligence, risk, compliance, and financial assessment tools.
* Knowledge of global procurement processes and operating models within the biopharmaceutical industry.
* Ability to demonstrate data and analytics to drive category decisions and project outcomes
* Experience managing or coaching professional\-level employees preferred.
* Working knowledge of sourcing and contracting tools, ERP systems, and eRFx platforms (e.g., Oracle, Zycus, Ariba) preferred.

title: Vulnerability Management Program + Anthropic - Manager
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
 Join Deloitte Cyber to help clients identify, assess, and reduce exposure across their digital environment. As a Manager, you will lead vulnerability management and attack surface management efforts by driving program execution, improving visibility into asset risk, and helping stakeholders prioritize remediation actions. You will work with global teams, enterprise security tools, and reporting frameworks to strengthen cyber situational awareness and support resilient operations.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Manager on the Cyber Defense \& Resilience team, you will be responsible for…
   

  

* Lead the design, implementation, and day\-to\-day management of vulnerability management activities across client environments
* Develop and maintain policies, standards, procedures, and reporting processes for vulnerability assessment, prioritization, and remediation
* Oversee scanning, testing, and analysis activities using enterprise tools to identify vulnerabilities, rogue assets, and exposure trends
* Communicate risk posture, remediation progress, and key metrics to technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership
* Drive continuous improvement by identifying asset data gaps, supporting program reporting, and advancing the vulnerability management roadmap


**The team**
 Cyber Defense \& Resilience teams assist clients in identifying, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities across their digital ecosystem through robust Attack Surface Management (ASM). By continuously monitoring client environments—networks, applications, cloud assets, and endpoints—they proactively uncover potential exposure points before threat actors can exploit them. Attack Surface Management (ASM) is a foundational capability within the Cyber Defense \& Resilience portfolio, enabling proactive identification and mitigation of security vulnerabilities across an organization’s digital landscape.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru/Hyderabad/Pune/Chennai**
**Shift Timings: General**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 9\+ years of experience in vulnerability management, information security, application security, or technical cybersecurity roles
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), or GIAC Continuous Monitoring Certification (GMON)
* Experience designing or managing vulnerability management programs
* Experience conducting vulnerability analysis using Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, or similar tools
* Experience with networking protocols, including Transmission Control Protocol/Internet Protocol (TCP/IP), Domain Name System (DNS), and Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)
* Experience using Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures (CVE) and Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) frameworks


 Preferred:
   

  

* Experience developing metrics, dashboards, or executive reporting on vulnerability status and remediation progress
* Experience with asset provisioning or deprovisioning lifecycle processes
* Experience with patch management tools such as Microsoft Intune or Red Hat Satellite
* Experience analyzing malicious code activity, distributed denial of service (DDoS), or network scanning activity
* Experience with Confluence, Jira, or Configuration Management Databases (CMDBs) such as ServiceNow
* Experience with databases, query design, or data analysis

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

 Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
   

  

**Professional development**
 At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state\-of\-the\-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .

 At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. description:
**Role: Operations Consultant** 




  





**Who We Are:** 




 Streamliners is a management consulting firm specialized in rapid efficiency improvements, operational excellence, and fast turnaround. We help manufacturers and private equity owned portfolio companies in North America and Europe solve complex operational challenges to maximize profit margins and gain competitive advantage. At our core, we are doers. We work closely with clients in various industries to execute the steps required to achieve performance improvements.
 



  





**Who You Are:** 




 A experienced and self\-directed problem solver. A change management champion. You not only work well with others, but also can operate autonomously with little direction. You go the extra mile, and your entrepreneurial drive and intellectual curiosity have helped you garner a track\-record of achievement.
 



  





 You should feel second nature conducting \& leading the following analysis:
 


* Process Capacity \& Utilization Modeling
* Bottleneck Analysis
* Waste Reduction
* Warehouse Restructuring
* KPI Creation
* Root Cause Analysis
* Workforce Analysis



  





**The Role:** 




 You will work alongside other consultants and clients, typically on site, to deliver transformation objectives. You will have ownership of workstreams and be responsible for executing effective improvement plans within operations, ranging from shop floor improvements to fundamental changes in work processes and information and material flows. You’ll also serve clients in a project manager capacity for turnarounds, transformations, and expansions.
 



  





**Duties / Responsibilities:** 



* Serve as project leader for project workstreams, transformations, and turnarounds
* Problem\-solve technical manufacturing issues using structured methodologies
* Use facts and data to prioritize improvement opportunities
* You will adopt a process\-oriented approach to solving problems and will break a large complex problem into a series of smaller, more manageable modules.
* Drive change and improvements to the overall execution of client operations
* Transform manufacturing processes for better productivity and efficiency
* Conduct due diligence, benchmarking, best practice, and other assessment studies
* Recommend actions and help clients implement them
* Manage and deliver the highest quality client work



  





**Qualifications:** 



* 4\+ years of experience in a high\-performance manufacturing environment
* 3\+ years leadership and management experience
* Bachelor’s degree (Master’s preferred) in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics), Operations, or Business
* Strong functional knowledge in one or more of the following: discrete manufacturing, project management, process automation, continuous improvement
* Ability to work effectively and collaboratively with people at all levels in an organization
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* **Willingness to travel to US and Europe 2 or 3 months in year**



  





**Preferred:** 



* Background in Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt is a plus) and methodologies including but not limited to Kaizen methods, JIT, Kanban, SMED, 5S, Poka Yoke, Visual Workplace, and VSM
* Experience in management consulting, large\-scale change management, or turnaround and restructurings
* Direct operating experience with P\&L accountability
* International work experience



 Please send your updated resume to
 **mrudula.arumilli@streamliners.us** 
 only if you have experience working with consulting firms

Design Manager
 



  





**Location:** 

 Hyderabad
 




**Reporting To:** 

 Senior Design Head
 




  





**COMPANY OVERVIEW:** 





 Tint Tone and Shade is a premium interior design and home transformation company dedicated to creating beautiful, functional, and personalized living spaces. We specialize in end\-to\-end interior solutions, combining innovative design, quality craftsmanship, and exceptional customer service to deliver outstanding experiences for homeowners.
 




  





**POSITION SUMMARY:** 





 The Design Manager owns the entire design department's output, people, and process. The role holds full people\-management responsibility for the design team (Assistant Design Manager, Lead Designer, Senior/Associate/Junior Designers), is accountable for design quality and delivery across all live projects, and is the primary design interface with Sales, Production, and Site leadership.
 




  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




  






 Team \& People Management
 





 • Manage the full design team's structure, workload distribution, and capacity planning.
 





 • Set individual and team targets; conduct performance reviews and development planning.
 





 • Hire, onboard, and train designers; identify and close skill gaps across the team.
 





 • Manage escalations, conflicts, and performance issues within the team.
 




  






 Design Quality \& Delivery Ownership
 





 • Own final design sign\-off standards across all projects before client presentation.
 





 • Ensure consistent design quality, brand alignment, and execution feasibility department\-wide.
 





 • Review and resolve high\-value or high\-risk project issues escalated by Lead Designer/Assistant Design Manager.
 




  






 Business \& Cross\-Functional Alignment
 





 • Partner with Sales leadership on design\-led proposals, pitch strategy, and conversion improvement.
 





 • Align with Production and Procurement on cost, material, and timeline feasibility at a portfolio level.
 





 • Represent the design function in leadership/management reviews.
 




  






 Process, Systems \& Reporting
 





 • Own design department SOPs, tools, and CRM/documentation standards.
 





 • Track and report department\-wide KPIs, capacity utilization, and pipeline health to leadership.
 





 • Drive continuous improvement in design turnaround time, cost efficiency, and client satisfaction.
 




  






 Budget \& Resource Ownership
 





 • Manage design department budget, including software, resources, and training spend.
 





 • Approve resourcing decisions (freelancers, additional hires) based on pipeline demand.
 




  





**KEY SUCCESS METRICS (KPIs)** 





 • Department\-wide proposal\-to\-booking conversion rate.
 





 • Department\-wide on\-time delivery rate for drawings/BOQs.
 





 • Overall client satisfaction score (CSAT) across all projects.
 





 • Department\-wide design\-to\-execution deviation rate.
 





 • Team attrition/retention and average time\-to\-productivity for new hires.
 





 • Escalations resolved at department level vs. escalated further.
 





 • Design department cost efficiency (cost per project / budget adherence).
 





 • Number of team members promoted/upskilled within the year.
 




  





**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS** 




  





**Education** 





 • Bachelor's/Master's degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or a related field.
 





 • Strong command of design software (AutoCAD, SketchUp, 3ds Max/V\-Ray, or similar).
 




  





**Experience** 





 • 9–10 years in interior design, including 3\+ years directly managing a design team.
 





 • Proven experience owning department\-level delivery, budgets, and people management.

**Event Production Manager** 




**Company:**

**Working Hours:** 
  Depends on Events timings. Dynamic in nature.
 



**Probation:** 
  3 months
 



**Weekly Off:** 
  Depends on Events timings. Dynamic in nature.
 



  





**About We Connect** 




 We Connect is a Hyderabad\-based event management company delivering corporate events, exhibitions, brand activations, seminars, promotions, sports events and other experiential projects.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for hands\-on Event Production Managers to support the planning and execution of events from preparation through completion. The role involves coordinating with vendors, fabricators, internal teams and venues to ensure that event requirements are delivered on time and as planned.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Coordinate production requirements for events, exhibitions and activations.
* Work with fabricators, printers, vendors, technicians and rental partners.
* Coordinate event elements such as stages, stalls, branding, signage, backdrops, displays and other installations.
* Prepare production checklists, timelines and material requirements.
* Follow up with vendors to ensure timely delivery and quality.
* Review designs, measurements and specifications before production.
* Assist with venue setup, installation, event\-day execution and dismantling.
* Coordinate with the internal Design, Marketing and Project teams.
* Identify production issues early and find practical solutions.
* Maintain basic records of quotations, requirements, materials and vendor details.
* Support multiple projects and manage deadlines effectively.



  





**Requirements** 



* 1–3 years of experience in event production, event management, exhibitions, activations or a related field.
* Practical understanding of fabrication, printing, branding and event setups.
* Good vendor coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Strong organisational and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work under tight timelines and handle last\-minute changes.
* Good communication and interpersonal skills.
* Willingness to work on\-ground during events and extended hours when required.
* Knowledge of basic event technical requirements such as AV, lighting and power is an advantage.
* Existing vendor or fabrication experience is a plus.



  





**Ideal Candidate** 




 Someone who is organised, proactive and hands\-on, takes ownership of assigned work, communicates clearly and is comfortable solving problems in a fast\-paced event environment.
 



  





**Success in 6 Months** 



* Independently handle production requirements for assigned events.
* Build dependable vendor relationships.
* Deliver assigned work within timelines and specifications.
* Minimise last\-minute production issues through effective planning.
* Confidently support on\-ground event execution.



  





**Career Growth** 




 Event Production Manager → Senior Production Manager → Production Lead → Event Operations Manager
 



  





**Selection Process** 




 Candidates will undergo an interview and a practical assessment focused on event production planning, coordination, problem\-solving and execution. There will be two interview rounds and hiring will be finalised within a total 2 week process.
 


* Overtime will be compensated as per company policy. Benefits will be discussed during the hiring process.

title: Shift Manager
description:
**Business Unit:**
 Cubic Transportation Systems
   

  

**Company Details:**
 When you join Cubic, you become part of a company that creates and delivers technology solutions in transportation to make people’s lives easier by simplifying their daily journeys, and defense capabilities to help promote mission success and safety for those who serve their nation. Led by our talented teams around the world, Cubic is committed to solving global issues through innovation and service to our customers and partners.
   

  

 We have a top\-tier portfolio of businesses, including Cubic Transportation Systems (CTS) and Cubic Defense (CD). Explore more on Cubic.com.
   

  

**Job Details:**
**Job Summary**
 As a Shift Coordinator on the CTS 24x7 Service Operations team, you will provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 staff across the Network Operations Center (NOC), Security Operations Center (SOC), and Service Desk during your assigned shift. You act as the technical and operational command authority during the shift. You are responsible for ensuring that events across all three functions are correctly triaged, tickets are properly assigned and tracked, incidents are escalated per defined protocols, and shift handovers preserve full situational awareness for the incoming shift.
   

  

 You are responsible for confirming shift staffing coverage in real time and for adjusting assignments to accommodate last\-minute absences. You are the immediate escalation path for issues that exceed the authority of the Tier 1 and Tier 2 analysts on the shift, and you escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for issues that exceed shift authority.
   

  

 Work is conducted under the compliance frameworks that govern CTS operations, in particular ITIL 4 (Monitoring and Event Management, Incident Management, Continual Improvement), ISO/IEC 27001:2022 (Annex A logging, monitoring, and incident management controls), and PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 (Requirements 10 and 12\.10\). You will be recognized inside CTS as the shift\-level owner for cross\-function coordination and evidence continuity.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Essential Job Duties and Responsibilities**
**Shift Command and Team Coordination**
* Provide direct supervision to Tier 1 and Tier 2 NOC, SOC, and Service Desk analysts during the assigned shift.
* Assign work at shift start and re\-balance workload throughout the shift based on ticket volume, incident severity, and individual analyst capacity.
* Confirm complete shift coverage across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues at shift start; adjust in real time when staff are unavailable because of sick calls, unplanned PTO, or emergency absence.
* Serve as the initial escalation point for any Tier 1 or Tier 2 analyst who needs additional authority, judgment, or cross\-functional coordination.
* Track and report shift\-level metrics (ticket volume, SLA adherence, incident count by severity) at shift close.


**Shift Handover Discipline**
* Execute a formal shift handover at the start and end of every shift, per the protocols defined in the NOC Scope Definition and the CTS SOC Scope of Operations.
* Ensure the handover record captures, at minimum: open incidents with owner and next action; active containment actions in progress; watchlist items; active maintenance windows; tooling or coverage gaps.
* Retain handover records as ISMS evidence supporting ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.10 and ITIL 4 Monitoring and Event Management practice.


**Incident Management Coordination**
* Apply ITIL 4 Incident Management practice throughout the shift: validate alerts, classify severity, assign ownership, coordinate escalation, and track resolution against SLA.
* Coordinate the first 15 to 30 minutes of any SEV 0 or SEV 1 incident: declare the incident, engage the appropriate tiers, initiate stakeholder communications, and hand off to the Incident Commander or on\-call Tier 3 engineer.
* Enforce severity special rules from the NOC Scope Definition (for example, loss of logging or monitoring is never a SEV 4 event; SEV 0 or SEV 1 with a recent production change requires a change correlation step).
* Ensure joint NOC\-SOC coordination during Major Incidents: NOC leads operational recovery; SOC leads security investigation and containment; the Shift Coordinator maintains the shared incident bridge until the Incident Commander takes over.


**Cross\-Function Ticket Routing and Escalation**
* Monitor NOC, SOC, and Service Desk queues in the ITSM platform; ensure tickets are correctly categorized and assigned per the RACI.
* Route security\-relevant events from the NOC or Service Desk to the SOC per the defined Escalation pathway with enriched context.
* Route operational recovery actions from the SOC to the NOC or regional IT Operations per the defined protocol.
* Escalate to the Director of Technical Service Operations for any issue that exceeds shift authority.


**Compliance Evidence and Documentation**
* Ensure shift activities produce audit\-ready evidence supporting PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 Requirement 10 and Requirement 12\.10, and ISO/IEC 27001:2022 A.5\.24\-A.5\.28 and A.8\.15\-A.8\.16\.
* Verify handover records, incident timelines, and containment action logs are complete and accurate before shift close.
* Support monthly and quarterly evidence pack preparation.


**Continuous Improvement Contribution**
* Identify recurring patterns during the shift (repeat incidents, noisy alerts, gaps in playbook coverage) and log them for review by the NOC, SOC, and Service Desk Managers.
* Participate in post\-incident reviews and contribute to the Continual Improvement Register per ITIL 4 Continual Improvement practice.
* Recommend changes to shift\-level procedures where the shift experience identifies opportunities.


**General Duties And Responsibilities**
* Reliably demonstrate accountability for work assignments and proactive communications about issues and status. A strong history of proactively identifying effective solutions for challenges.
* Able to work effectively and uphold professional standards, with the customer and system stakeholders.
* Self\-motivated and able to work unsupervised.
* Methodical and attentive to detail.
* Proactive in seeking advice from senior operations and security subject matter experts when required.
* Comfortable working with staff at all levels and in other geographical locations within the organization.
* Comply with Cubic's Quality Management System.
* Comply with Cubic's quality, health, safety, and security policies.
* Support the company's strategic objectives and collaborate across departments.
* Comply with Cubic Human Resources Procedures.


**Skills / Experience / Knowledge**
**Essential:**
* Experience providing direct supervision to a team of individual contributors in a technology operations, security operations, or service desk environment.
* Working knowledge of NOC operations: event monitoring, incident management, SLA management, change and configuration control.
* Working knowledge of SOC operations: SIEM and EDR alert triage, security incident classification, escalation protocols.
* Working knowledge of Service Desk operations under a Tier 1\-3 tiered model.
* Familiarity with ITIL 4 practices, in particular Monitoring and Event Management and Incident Management.
* Ability to interpret and explain incident status, containment actions, and escalation decisions to peers, subordinate staff, and functional peer groups. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Collaboration and Interaction expectations.
* Sound judgment in resolving problems that require analysis of data and relevant factors under real\-time pressure. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Complexity and Problem Solving expectations.
* Ability to develop and manage routine operational plans and meet targets against a monthly performance plan. Consistent with Cubic Path Matrix M2 Discretion and Impact expectations.
* Experience preparing accurate shift reports and handover records.
* Comfort operating 24x7 shift patterns, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.


**Desirable:**
* Familiarity with PCI DSS v4\.0\.1 requirements, in particular Requirement 10, Requirement 11\.5, and Requirement 12\.10\.
* Familiarity with ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls covering logging (A.8\.15\), monitoring activities (A.8\.16\), and incident management (A.5\.24 to A.5\.28\).
* Exposure to NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2\.0 (NIST CSWP 29\) Detect and Respond Functions.
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow (or equivalent enterprise ITSM) and Jira.
* Understanding of the ITIL 4 Major Incident model and Problem Management practice.
* Experience coordinating across NOC, SOC, and Service Desk boundaries.


**Qualifications**
**Essential:**
* Must be able to work on\-site at Cubic Hyderabad, Aparna Plaza, on a 24x7 rotating shift pattern.
* Minimum 5\-8 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree.
* University degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or other technical field; or Business Administration with relevant IT work experience.
* At least 5 years of experience in a Tier 1\-3 operations environment (NOC, SOC, Service Desk, or NOC/SOC hybrid).
* At least 3 years’ experience managing shift workers.
* Demonstrated ability to make severity classification and escalation decisions in a real\-time operations setting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead a team through a shift, including workload assignment, coaching, and formal handover.
* At least 3 years’ experience working in an ITIL 4 operation.


**Desirable:**
* ITIL 4 Foundation certification; ITIL 4 Managing Professional or Strategic Leader preferred.
* CompTIA Security\+, ISC2 SSCP, or equivalent security operations certification.
* ServiceNow ITSM administrator or user certification.
* Experience in a payment card processing environment, or in a similarly regulated real\-time operations environment.
* Experience with global follow\-the\-sun shift models spanning NAM, EMEA, and APAC time zones.


**Condition of Employment:**
 Successful outcome of a National Police Check

 Employee

title: Clinical Trial Manager
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high\-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late\-stage pipeline. The company’s patient\-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro\-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
   

  

 Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The Clinical Trial Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, oversight, and delivery of early phase clinical trials. The CPM serves as the operational leader for assigned studies, partnering cross\-functionally with the Clinical Development Lead / Clinical Scientist, Drug Safety, Regulatory, Data Management, Quality, and external vendors to ensure clinical trials are delivered on time, within budget, and in compliance with applicable regulations and quality standards.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the operational execution of assigned domestic or global early phase clinical trial(s) including oversight of selected vendor(s)/CRO to ensure accountability, quality, and on time delivery of key project deliverables.
* Develop and manage study timelines, contract/budget negotiations, and risk mitigation plans to ensure delivery on timeline and financial goals are met.
* Initiate and manage request for proposal activities for assigned clinical studies or clinical development vendors, including CROs, specialty lab vendors, bioanalytical vendors, etc.
* Lead study execution team comprised of cross\-functional representatives from Regulatory, Drug Safety, Medical, Drug Supply, Data Management, Biostatistics, and Quality to oversee CRO vendors and ensure study excellence.
* Manage clinical development vendors according to vendor oversight plans.
* Oversee all study\-level data monitoring activities, reviews monitoring visit reports, and conducts Sponsor oversight monitoring visits as required.
* Responsible for monthly Protocol Deviation (PD) review, including oversight of CRA documentation and collaboration with Medical Monitor for medical review.
* Prepares and/or reviews study\-related study plans/documents; reviews site study documents.
* May assist in strategic trial design and protocol writing and reviewing / contributing to clinical regulatory documents to support upcoming programs (regulatory submissions, clinical overviews, pediatric study plans, etc.).
* Strategic country/site selection with program input and ensuring consistency across all clinical projects for therapeutic area.
* Ensures all clinical trials are executed in compliance with ICH/GCP guidelines/regulations and applicable SOPs: participates in the planning of quality assurance activities and coordinates resolution of audit findings; ensures audit\-ready condition of clinical trial documentation including central clinical files, Trial Master File (TMF), and clinical trial registry submissions.
* Ensure inspection readiness and compliance with ICH\-GCP, FDA, EMA, and applicable regulatory requirements.


**Required Skills And Experience**
* Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.
* 10 years minimum experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry including Contract Research Organization (CRO), pharmaceutical/biotechnology company, or clinical research environment (e.g., CRA, site coordinator, drug safety specialist, regulatory\-clinical specialist), including 5\+ years of clinical project/trial management (PM) or equivalent clinical operations experience.
* Knowledge of international regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, GCP, GMP, GDPR).
* Experience in and knowledge of the pharmaceutical development process


**Preferred Qualifications**
* 5\+ years’ experience of clinical trial management for early phase studies conducted in the US and India
* Broad understanding of regulatory GMP requirements for IMP product packaging and supply
* Excellent organizational and leadership skills.
* Effective communicator who can manage multiple priorities while building strong internal relationships across multiple departments.


 By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

You will support benchmarking activities across diverse sources, with the aim of harmonizing existing processes and driving process transformation to establish a best\-in\-class standard. You will lead and implement project plans of overall process improvement activities to meet business requirements and drive business results. **Process Transformation**

 Drive benchmarking across various sources, standardize current processes and transform processes to set a best\-in\-class new standard.

description:

This role requires a hands\-on leader who can balance strategic planning with operational execution while partnering closely with stakeholders across all business functions.
